jobs.description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

What is The Role:

We are looking for a hands-on Full-Stack Senior Software Engineer to join our IT Software Engineering team reporting directly to the Director, IT Software Engineering.

Inside IT Software Engineering, we are shifting from a traditional "SaaS-only" procurement model to an agile Build and Buy strategy. Powered by the Elastic Stack—Elasticsearch, Kibana, Elastic ML, and native AI capabilities—our team builds custom, enterprise-grade applications and AI-powered bots for internal teams (IT, HR, Finance, Ops), replacing expensive third-party software contracts with faster, native solutions.

This is a 100% individual contributor (IC) engineering role. You will lead the technical design, development, and deployment of full-stack internal web applications and conversational AI bots. You will write clean React and Node.js code, integrate backend services natively with Elasticsearch, and leverage modern AI development tools (Cursor, Claude, Copilot) to accelerate delivery—all while taking complete operational ownership of production systems.

What You Will Be Doing:


Build Enterprise Applications: Write clean, maintainable code across React, TypeScript, and Node.js to design and ship full-stack applications that replace legacy SaaS tools.
Develop AI Bots & Workflows: Architect and deploy intelligent internal bots using LLMs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and vector search to automate routine employee workflows and support requests.
Build on the Elastic Stack: Connect internal apps directly to Elasticsearch and Kibana, turning our internal tooling into real-world reference architectures for Elastic products.
Accelerate Delivery with AI Tools: Utilize modern AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude, Copilot) to write code faster, generate tests, and increase overall feature velocity.
Maintain Code Quality & Operations: Write unit and end-to-end tests, run automated CI/CD deployment pipelines, use feature flags, and participate in on-call rotations to ensure high uptime.


What You Bring:


8+ years of hands-on full-stack development experience building, shipping, and operating web applications in production using React, TypeScript, and Node.js.
Hands-on Elasticsearch experience with data modeling, indexing, query optimization, and Kibana dashboard integration.
Practical AI & bot engineering experience working with LLM APIs, vector search, RAG pipelines, or conversational bot frameworks.
Daily proficiency with AI coding tools (Cursor, Claude, or GitHub Copilot) to accelerate workflow while taking full responsibility for code quality.
Operational & testing maturity: Experience with automated testing (React Testing Library, Cypress/Playwright), CI/CD pipelines, feature flags, and on-call rotation for production services.


Bonus Points:


Experience building or integrating internal developer portals, FinOps/cost-governance platforms, or enterprise ticketing and automation workflows.
Exposure to advanced Elastic Stack capabilities (ELSER semantic search, hybrid vector search, or Elastic ML).
Background replacing legacy enterprise platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira, custom SaaS portals) with custom software solutions.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related engineering field.
Strong communication and problem solving skills with the ability to translate business requirements into technical agent architectures.
Ability to work and thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment.


Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People:

As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.

We strive to have parity of benefits across regions, and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.

Ensure that all individual contributions follow Elastic’s Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF). jobs.description:
About Dotfile

Dotfile is building the AI-native Compliance Operating System for financial institutions. Our mission is to make compliance simple, safe and smart, helping financial institutions onboard customers, manage risk and operate globally.

Compliance remains one of the most manual functions in financial services. While most institutions still rely on fragmented tools and human-driven workflows, we believe AI is enabling a fundamental shift toward autonomous compliance. Our ambition is to build Level 5 Compliance: software that can gather evidence, investigate complex situations, assess risk and execute defensible decisions under defined policies.

Dotfile has grown into one of Europe’s fastest-growing compliance technology companies. Today, 100+ financial institutions across 15 countries rely on Dotfile for critical compliance operations, with a rapidly growing presence in the US.

We recently raised our Series A from leading US and European investors and software operators. We’re now entering our next chapter: investing heavily in product and AI, expanding internationally, and building the team that can make Dotfile the global standard for compliance infrastructure.

About The Role

You’ll join an AI-native engineering team where AI is central to how we design, build and ship software. We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer who understands software deeply, uses AI to build better software faster, and wants to help improve how the whole team works.

You will own projects from understanding the customer problem to shipping a solution and improving it in production. Working closely with engineering and product, you will help decide what we build, how we build it, and where to invest as the platform grows.

This is a hands-on role with broad ownership. Your focus will reflect your strengths and the team’s priorities, whether that means building product experiences, developing backend services, or solving challenges across the platform. We value engineers who bring depth in their area and curiosity beyond it.

What You’ll Do


Own projects from discovery and technical design through implementation, testing, deployment and follow-up.
Work closely with product and other engineers to understand customer needs, challenge assumptions and turn complex requirements into clear, usable software.
Build and improve the interfaces, APIs and services that financial institutions rely on for their compliance operations.
Make pragmatic technical decisions, balancing delivery speed with reliability, security and maintainability.
Investigate production issues and improve performance, observability and resilience as the platform grows.
Raise the engineering bar through knowledge sharing and improvements to how we develop and ship software.
Contribute to the evolution of our platform as we build more AI-powered compliance capabilities.


About You


You have 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of delivering and maintaining software in production.
You understand software in depth. You bring strong fundamentals and depth in backend or full-stack development. You can reason about data, concurrency, performance and failure modes, and investigate unfamiliar systems beyond the surface.
AI coding agents are central to how you work. You use tools such as Codex or Claude Code extensively to explore, build, test and review software. You keep experimenting with ways to make yourself more effective.
You bring the judgment that makes AI-assisted development work. You frame problems clearly, provide useful context, challenge assumptions and verify the resulting behavior. You can explain why a solution works and take responsibility for what you ship.
You take ownership. You can turn an ambiguous problem into a practical plan, follow through on delivery and improve the result in production. You are comfortable learning new technologies and working beyond your usual area when a problem calls for it.
You care about the product as much as the implementation. You want to understand who you are building for, challenge requirements when needed and assess whether your work solves the original problem.
You value simple, well-designed solutions. You know when to move quickly and when reliability, security or long-term maintenance require more care.
You communicate clearly in English and enjoy collaborating. You explain your technical choices, welcome constructive disagreement and share what you learn with your teammates.
You want to help shape an AI-native engineering team. You enjoy improving how software gets built, from reusable agent workflows to better testing and feedback loops, and turning your own discoveries into practices that make the whole team more effective.


Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech or compliance is a plus.

Our technology

Our Main Language Is TypeScript. Our Stack Includes


Frontend: React, Apollo GraphQL and Storybook.
Backend: Node.js, NestJS, GraphQL and PostgreSQL.
Infrastructure: AWS and Kubernetes.
Development and testing: Nx, GitLab CI, Playwright.


You do not need experience with every part of our stack. We care about your engineering judgment, your ability to learn and the quality of the software you build.

Why join us


Join a company with traction and room to shape its future. With 100+ financial institutions using Dotfile and a recent Series A, you’ll help define the next stage of the product and engineering team.
Help shape how an AI-native team works. Experiment with new approaches, improve your own workflow and turn what you learn into practices that make the whole team more effective.
Put your engineering depth to work. Solve demanding problems in automation, AI, data and reliability, building software that financial institutions depend on every day.
Have a direct say in what you build. Influence technical decisions, own projects through to production, and see how your work changes the customer experience.


Our hiring process


CTO conversation — 30-60 minutes : Discuss your background, explore the role and how our engineering team works, and answer technical questions to assess your engineering knowledge and problem-solving approach.
Case study — 60 minutes : Design the architecture of a project we provide, or present the architecture of a past project you led. Walk us through your reasoning, technical decisions and trade-offs.
Raise the bar — 30 minutes: Meet someone from Product or Solutions Consulting to discuss how you collaborate across teams, understand customer needs and approach problems together.
Founder discussion — 15-30 minutes: Meet our CEO to discuss Dotfile’s ambition, what motivates you and the contribution you could make.

Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes. Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram.  Who you are:

We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Software Developer who will be part of a team who builds a state of the art telematics platform that makes sense of the data collected by custom-built hardware. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

What you'll do:

As a Software Developer your key area of responsibility will be writing high-performance Java, Python and Go code and SQL queries to process and store data in real-time, as well as writing JavaScript and TypeScript code to create fast and responsive user interfaces. You will need to work closely with other members of the development and technical teams.

To be successful in this role you will be a strong team-player with an entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable in a flat organization, highly organized, and able to work well under pressure to respond to fast changing priorities and deadlines. In addition, the successful candidate will have excellent written and oral communication skills, strong analytical skills with the ability to problem-solve to well-judged decisions, and the ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.

How you'll make an impact:
Listen and contribute to design discussions and make detailed notes and documenting requirements and technical design.
Provide guidance to more junior team members, sharing knowledge across the teams.
Write scalable, high quality and secure software in a variety of programming languages and environments, such as Java, Python, Go, JavaScript, SQL.

Perform quality assurance by doing peer review, ensuring coding standards are followed, looking for logic errors and other bugs.
Analyze call stacks, trace files, performance data to troubleshoot and identify the root cause of bugs.

Participate in development of prototypes, minimum viable products and proofs of concept.

Provide assistance to our support staff and resellers from a technical perspective. This may be in the form of on-call or ad-hoc questions
relating to how certain features work or verifying the behaviour by reviewing code.

Research new language features, frameworks and other relevant technologies and offer recommendations to Leads and senior leaders.

Assist in defining best practices to be used in the team.

Provide design documents and documentation to ensure efficient maintenance and code reuse.

Ensure the functionality, performance, scalability, reliability, realistic implementation schedules and system architecture for each assignment.

Participate in a 24x7 on-call rotating schedule.
What you'll bring to the role:
1 - 5 years of required previous experience in a related field.
Post-secondary Diploma/Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

Knowledge of multiple general purpose programming languages (e.g. C#, Java, Python), as well as experience with Python, Google Compute Engine, and Google BigQuery.
Working knowledge of Cloud computing experience with GCP, AWS and/or Azure.
Technical competence using software programs, including, but not limited to, Google Suite for business (Sheets, Docs, Slides).

MÔ TẢ CÔNG VIỆC: 
Tham gia vào các dự án phần mềm với doanh nghiệp Nhật Bản

Làm việc tại Việt Nam, có cơ hội công tác ở Nhật Bản
 YÊU CẦU:
Tối thiểu 5–6 năm phát triển backend, trong đó ít nhất 3 năm chuyên sâu với Node.js (NestJS/Express/Fastify).
Đã từng thiết kế và đưa vào production ít nhất một hệ thống có quy mô thật (nhiều service hoặc lượng truy cập/dữ liệu đáng kể), không chỉ tham gia một phần nhỏ.

Microservices & system integration: phân tách service theo bounded context, giao tiếp đồng bộ (REST/gRPC) vs bất đồng bộ (queue), API Gateway, load balancing.

Kinh nghiệm quản lý team size ít nhất 3 người trở lên.

Collaboration & Ownership

Review code, improve standards, and contribute to overall engineering quality
Help shape technical direction and best practices as the team grows

Minimum of three years of professional experience.

Strong experience as a Full Stack Engineer working with:

Deep expertise in data modeling

About The Company

AIQ is an Abu Dhabi-based technology company that develops and deploys industrial artificial intelligence (AI) technologies at scale, focused on the energy sector. As a venture between Presight (G42) and ADNOC, AIQ has productized 15 AI-enabled solutions that support clients to perform better, protect teams and equipment, keep operations sustainable, and rapidly scale successes. The organization embraces an innovative and entrepreneurial spirit, looking to push boundaries and solve transformational challenges across industry. It welcomes professionals that share the desire to make meaningful and impactful contributions to the mission to deliver responsible AI to the heart of industrial processes. Always on the forefront of technology, AIQ provides its talent with an environment to thrive and excel. Working at AIQ includes participating in some of the most significant industrial transformation projects, interacting with massive data pools, utilizing sophisticated AI infrastructure that is powered by a NVIDIA GPU cloud computing platform, and access to abundant computing, storage, and network resources made available from across the G42 ecosystem.

Overview

AIQ is looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join its digital and AI solutions team, building next-generation applications that support the transformation

of oil and gas operations. The role involves developing scalable, cloud-native full-stack systems that integrate advanced AI capabilities into real-world

industrial use cases. You will work across backend and frontend technologies to deliver high-performance applications, while collaborating closely with AI

engineers, data scientists, and domain experts to translate complex requirements into robust, production-ready solutions. We encourage the use of AIassisted

development tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate delivery — but ownership stays with the engineer: you're expected to

understand, validate, and stand behind everything shipped.

Responsibilities


Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack applications supporting AI-driven solutions for oil & gas operations.
Develop responsive and performant frontend applications using modern JavaScript frameworks (React, Angular, or equivalent).
Build robust backend services and APIs using modern frameworks (e.g., Python/FastAPI, Node.js) following microservices and event-driven architecture.
Work with large-scale structured and unstructured data through APIs, data services, and integration layers.
Collaborate closely with AI engineers, data scientists, and domain experts to translate requirements into scalable digital products.
Design and implement cloud-native solutions using AWS, Azure, or GCP, including containerized deployments (Docker, Kubernetes).
Integrate AI/ML services and models (developed by data science teams) into production-grade applications.
Ensure application performance, scalability, security, and reliability across distributed systems.
Contribute to system design, architecture discussions, and engineering best practices, with growing ownership over key technical decisions.
Use AI coding assistants and agentic dev tools to accelerate implementation and testing, while applying strong engineering judgment to review and validate AI-generated output before it ships.
Participate in CI/CD automation, DevOps workflows, and continuous improvement of delivery pipelines.
Support integration with industrial systems and data sources (e.g., IoT, SCADA, enterprise platforms).
Mentor junior and mid-level engineers on full-stack best practices, including effective and responsible use of AI-assisted tooling.


Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (Master's preferred).
5–8 years of experience in full-stack software development.
Strong experience in backend development using Python (FastAPI or similar) and/or Node.js.
Proven experience building frontend applications using React, Angular, or similar SPA frameworks with TypeScript.
Solid understanding of microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, and distributed systems design.
Experience working with relational and NoSQL databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc.).
Hands-on experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git-based workflows, and modern DevOps practices.
Familiarity with integrating AI/ML services or data-driven APIs into applications (consuming — not building models).
Understanding of event-driven architecture and messaging systems (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ).
Demonstrated experience using AI-assisted development tools in a production engineering workflow, with a track record of maintaining high code quality and ownership standards despite (or because of) increased velocity.
Strong problem-solving skills with ability to work independently in agile environments.
Prior experience mentoring engineers or leading technical initiatives is a plus.
Experience in oil & gas, energy, or industrial digitalization environments is a strong advantage.


What Working At AIQ Offers

Culture: Encouraging initiative, work in an environment that is fast-paced and varied, surrounded by talented peers from around the world, who are similarly attracted to applying their skills to solve transformational challenges.

Career: Join a team in which your contribution is recognized and rewarded, while you are supported to operate at your peak performance.

Rewards: An attractive renumeration package that includes healthcare, education support for dependents, leave benefits, and more.

We are building an enterprise AI platform in which AI agents operate business applications through their user interface, the way a person does. It runs inside customers' own environments, including on-premises and air-gapped sites. We are a small, senior team working in two-week sprints towards a first production release in December 2026.

We are hiring our first Frontend Design Engineer: an engineer with a strong eye for design who owns how the product looks, feels, and behaves. You will set the frontend foundations, meaning the design system, frontend architecture, and UI standards. You will design and build the interfaces people use to teach, supervise, and trust AI agents.

What you will do

Build and own the design system in Storybook: design tokens, theming, documented components, visual states, and accessibility checks.
Turn product ideas into usable interfaces: sketch, prototype, and iterate quickly in code and in Figma.
Design and build AI-native UI patterns:
live agent progress and step-by-step views of agent runs
tool-call and approval flows
error, retry, and human hand-over states
Design data-dense operational screens, such as review queues, audit trails, permission management, and monitoring dashboards, that stay clear and calm.
Build the main application screens in React and TypeScript, together with the Full-stack Engineer.
Set frontend tooling and standards: build (Vite or similar), linting, unit, component, and end-to-end tests, and visual regression testing.
Make sure the product is accessible (WCAG 2.1 AA), performs well (Core Web Vitals), and works in English and Arabic (RTL).

What we are looking for

Must have

10+ years of professional software engineering, with a strong focus on frontend development and UI design.
A portfolio or examples showing strong visual and interaction design skills in shipped products.
Strong React skills (hooks, composition, performance tuning) and TypeScript.
Hands-on experience building and maintaining design systems and component libraries with Storybook (stories, controls, docs, interaction and visual tests).
Excellent modern CSS (CSS Modules, Tailwind, or CSS-in-JS), layout, responsive design, and motion.
Fluency in Figma and in working with, or as, a product designer.
Working knowledge of accessibility standards and semantic HTML.
A track record of technical leadership: owning architecture decisions, mentoring engineers, and raising engineering standards across a team.

Nice to have

Experience designing agent, workflow, or streaming UIs (SSE, WebSockets).
Design tokens and theming at scale (e.g. Style Dictionary), or publishing a design system as a package.
Visualising graphs, timelines, or state machines (e.g. React Flow, D3).
Visual regression tooling (Chromatic, Playwright snapshots).
GraphQL clients (Apollo, urql, Relay).
Bilingual or RTL (Arabic) UI experience.

What we will assess

Portfolio review: walk us through interfaces you designed and built, and the decisions behind them.
Technical exercise: design and build a small React feature with Storybook stories and tests.
Design deep-dive: make an AI agent's actions understandable and controllable for a non-technical user.
Collaboration: working with product, backend, and AI engineers in a small team.

Why join

Founding role with full ownership of the design system and the product's look and feel.
Solve hard UX problems: making autonomous AI agents understandable, controllable, and trustworthy for enterprise and government users.

The successful candidates will contribute to the design, development, integration, and maintenance of software components underpinning mission-critical communications and operational capabilities, working within a multidisciplinary engineering environment alongside systems engineers, software architects, integration engineers, test teams, and operational stakeholders. Produce UI product/system requirement specifications based on end-user input and operational analysis, translating user needs to relevant functional engineering teams

Ensure software quality through disciplined development and verification: automated unit tests, integration/system/acceptance testing support, and code/peer reviews

jobs.description:
About the Role

We are an international fashion distribution business running Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central as our core ERP platform, integrated with warehouse, eCommerce and marketplace systems.




We are looking for a Business Central specialist who lives and breathes the platform. This is a purely BC-focused role: you will support, extend and improve a live, integrated BC environment, working internally as well as alongside our external development partner and internal stakeholders across the business. You will not be spread across ten different systems. Business Central is the job.




What You Will Do

Own day-to-day technical support of Business Central across our entities: troubleshoot posting issues, integration errors, permission problems and data questions, and see them through to resolution.
Develop and maintain AL extensions following Microsoft's development guidelines and AppSource-grade best practices: event subscribers over base app changes, proper object structure, clean upgrade paths.
Work with our external development partner on larger builds: review their pull requests, test deliverables against specs, and hold the line on code quality and scope.
Support and monitor our integration landscape: WMS interfaces, the Shopify, and others. Investigate failed messages, trace root causes, and propose fixes rather than workarounds.
Use AI tooling as a core part of how you work: AI-assisted coding for AL development, BC Copilot features, and AI agents where they genuinely reduce effort. We expect you to be curious and have a solid understanding about these tools, not resistant to them.
Translate business requests into clear technical requirements. Challenge when a request does not make sense by proposing the standard BC way before proposing customization.
Manage environment hygiene: sandbox refreshes, extension deployments, telemetry review, Feature Management, and preparation for BC major version upgrades.
Work directly with users at every level, from warehouse operators to finance leads to C-level, and communicate in the language each audience needs.




What You Must Bring

Business Central depth. 5+ years of hands-on Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central experience (or NAV with recent BC cloud experience) in a technical or techno-functional capacity.
AL development. Solid AL development skills in VS Code: table and page extensions, codeunits, event subscribers, APIs, report layouts. You know the base application well enough to find the right event before writing a line of code.
Best practices discipline. You follow Microsoft's published guidelines and community best practices by default. You read Microsoft Learn and the main BC MVP blogs, and you can justify your design choices against them.
Functional grounding. Understanding of BC's posting engine, dimensions, posting groups, item ledger and warehouse structures. You do not need to be an accountant, but you must understand what a posting group does before you touch one.
AI fluency. Practical experience using AI coding assistants (GitHub Copilot, Claude) to accelerate development and research, with the judgment to verify what they produce.
Critical thinking. You question requirements, spot the edge cases nobody mentioned, and think about what breaks downstream before you deploy. You prefer solving the actual problem over closing the ticket.
Stakeholder skills. Comfortable working with end users, finance teams, external partners and senior management. Patient with users, precise with developers, concise with executives.
Positive attitude, eagerness to continue learn and grow.
Prior experience within retail or distribution industries.
Fluent English, written and spoken.




Nice to Have

Exposure to Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Pages, Dataverse) in a BC context.
Experience in fashion.
Familiarity with Azure DevOps & GIT for source control and work item tracking.
Microsoft certification MB-800 (Business Central Functional Consultant) and/or AL developer credentials.

jobs.description:
At Sana Commerce, we’re committed to creating an inclusive environment because we know our diverse workforce is one of our greatest strengths.




Applications without demonstrable evidence of a product or prototype you built will not be reviewed.




Sana Commerce is building the future of B2B commerce for the agentic era, where buyers, sellers and agents interact and transact across every channel.

B2B commerce is going agentic. We are looking for a Head of Research and Design who already sees where this is heading, and who wants to take a team and a product there.

You lead this from the front. You own the point of view on how commerce products get built and experienced in an agentic world, you sharpen it through your own research, and you bring the frameworks, standards and ways of working the team needs before anyone thinks to ask for them. You lead the research and design team towards that vision. You set the direction, you stay in the work, and the team builds it with you.




What you’ll get:

The opportunity to make an impact at a fast-growing SaaS scale-up;
A global and customized onboarding program (9,1/10 rated by previous hires);
Working closely with global leaders on strategic initiatives;
Up to 8 weeks "work from anywhere" per year;
A hybrid working model - 3 days from the office, 2 days from home;




What you’ll be owning:

The team and the direction. Lead the research and design team towards a clear picture of what we are building: an AI-native product and an agentic commerce experience that buyers and sellers will actually use. You set the bar by doing the work alongside them.
The end-to-end experience. Designers here own the whole journey, not individual screens or isolated moments. You own how it holds together, where it earns trust, and how it performs, while the moments inside it are increasingly generated.
Agentic experience design. How agents behave, when they surface, and how transparency, control and fallback get designed in. Buyers and sellers will increasingly transact through conversational and headless interactions, with no screen in between.
An AI-native design system. A machine-readable, token-driven system that AI tooling consumes to generate consistent, high-fidelity design. Built to be picked up automatically, not maintained by hand.
The research agenda. Where the industry is heading on agentic commerce and the future of B2B commerce, how buyer and seller behavior is shifting, and what trust and privacy have to look like when an agent transacts on someone's behalf. The team is already working on these questions. You own where they go next.
The craft bar. A high standard for fidelity and quality, and the methods that let a small team hold it at speed.




What you’ll bring:

Proven experience building AI-powered or agentic products, with demonstrable examples of products, prototypes or agents you personally helped research, design or build
A strong portfolio of commercially shipped products used by real customers, demonstrating your personal contribution and measurable user or business impact.
Proven experience leading both product design and user research, owning the end-to-end product experience while remaining hands-on in research, prototyping and design.
A track record of using user, market and industry research to shape product direction, translating insights into a clear product and experience vision.
Practical AI fluency across the research and design process, including design systems built for AI generation: tokens, structure, and systems that scale without manual upkeep.
Experience leading and developing designers and researchers, setting direction and standards while working closely with Product Management and other product and technology disciplines.
Experience in e-commerce is strongly preferred, whether B2B or B2C. Experience with B2B commerce and complex buyer and seller journeys is particularly relevant.




Our values

At Sana Commerce, our values guide everything we do:

Champions of Our League – We balance quick wins with long-term success.
Supercharge Our Customers – We help our customers succeed by continuously improving their digital commerce experience.
Determined to Grow – We embrace challenges and keep raising the bar.
Bold Together – We achieve more by supporting one another.




How to apply

We care most about what you’ve built. When reviewing applications, we look for evidence in this order:

Live, working commercial and agentic products. The strongest signal by far. Share links and let the work speak for itself.
A design portfolio, if live products cannot be shared. Show end-to-end journeys, agentic and conversational experiences, and design-system artefacts built in an AI-native way.
Your CV. Useful context that helps us understand your experience and points us towards the commercial products or design work you’ve built.




Job descriptions don’t cover everything. Even if you do not meet every single requirement, we have ambitious plans and we value experienced professionals who share our vision and look forward to growing with us. If you believe your background is a strong match, we strongly encourage you to apply and include your motivation.

We are looking for a Business Systems Administrator & Analyst to provide hands-on operational support across Salesforce and connected business systems. The role combines Salesforce administration, systems and integration monitoring, business-user support, data reconciliation, reporting, testing and operational follow-up, with a focus on system reliability, accurate data and timely reporting.




Key Responsibilities

·      Perform day-to-day administration and routine configuration across Salesforce Commerce Cloud and Service Cloud, including users, roles, permissions and approved platform settings.

Support hands-on HTML updates and front-end content changes across Salesforce Commerce Cloud and other e-commerce platforms, ensuring accurate implementation of approved website content and campaign requirements.

·      Support product, content, promotion and campaign configuration across Salesforce and connected commerce/POS environments.

·      Monitor system integrations, scheduled jobs, APIs, synchronization processes and failed transactions across Salesforce and connected platforms.

·      Conduct hands-on first-level investigation of integration and system issues, identify the likely source of errors and coordinate resolution with the relevant technical teams or partners.

·      Provide functional support to business users and help resolve day-to-day Salesforce and connected-system requests.

·      Reconcile key business data across systems, monitor data quality and investigate discrepancies across customers, products, orders, inventory, transactions and promotions.

·      Build and maintain Salesforce reports and dashboards and support recurring BI reporting using Tableau or similar tools.

·      Translate business reporting requirements into practical metrics, dashboards and reports, validating source data and report logic.

·      Support user acceptance testing, regression testing and operational validation for system and integration changes, including post-release checks.

·      Maintain clear documentation, user guides and process notes and support user adoption and basic training.




Candidate Profile

jobs.description:
About Us:

ShlenPower builds digital products across AI, Web3 and the creator economy. We are hiring one Senior Product Manager to take full responsibility for product management across Attractor and Dlicom. Attractor is an AI platform for creators and businesses. Dlicom is a social and wallet app with creator monetisation. You will be the sole person responsible for the product function across both businesses, including the Product Owner work. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You will do the research and business analysis, shape the products, write the roadmaps and requirements, define the user journeys, work through delivery with the teams and measure what happens after release. You will work in our Dubai office with company leadership, engineering, design and growth.




What you will own:

Personally turn company goals, market research and user research into a clear product direction and a focused roadmap for each product. Explain who the user is, what problem matters now, how the product will earn money, whether the unit economics can work and what evidence would change the plan.
Map the full journey from first visit to first useful action, payment and repeat use. Identify where people drop out and work with growth and marketing to improve the experience after acquisition.
Conduct user and customer discovery, competitor research and business analysis yourself. Test important assumptions before committing development time, and make a clear recommendation when the evidence is incomplete.
Write the PRDs, user stories, journeys, flows, acceptance criteria, edge cases and release scope. Sketch the experience and work with design on screens. Work with engineers on implementation choices. Keep the product sections of whitepapers and other company materials accurate.
Work directly with engineering, design and QA each day. Resolve ambiguity early, make trade-offs visible, keep the backlog usable and accept releases against the agreed user outcome.
Define product events and review funnels, cohorts, retention, payment conversion and repeat revenue separately for Attractor and Dlicom. Investigate data quality before calling a feature successful.
Evaluate where AI improves the user experience, including model quality, evaluation, latency, cost and human review. For Web3 flows, understand wallets, transaction states, smart contracts and the choice between on-chain and off-chain work well enough to make sound product decisions with engineers.
Bring risks, missed assumptions and weak results to leadership with a proposed decision. Challenge a founder's idea when the evidence calls for it, and explain your reasoning.




What we need from you:

At least five years owning software products from discovery through launch and improvement, with regular work alongside developers. You have personally done the research, planning, requirements and analysis that make delivery possible.
A track record in both AI and Web3 products. Show at least one product in each field that reached sustained use or paid adoption, what you personally did, and how you measured the result.
Strong product judgement across user value, commercial viability, usability and technical feasibility. You can shape an ambiguous idea into a workable product and cut scope when the case for a feature is weak. You can manage two product roadmaps without waiting for someone else to define the work.
Fluency with product analytics, experiments, user interviews and cohort analysis. You can separate traffic from activation, and first payment from repeat payment.
Enough technical depth to discuss APIs, data flows, integrations, AI systems and blockchain transactions without relying on someone else to translate every decision.
Experience with creator monetisation, social products, subscriptions or marketplaces is valuable. Strong spoken and written English is essential.
Ability to work full time from our Dubai office.




How we will assess success:

In your first 90 days, we expect a clear baseline for each product's user and revenue journey, a prioritised roadmap tied to business goals, complete journeys and requirements for the work under way, and a regular review of releases against actual behaviour. You should be able to show which assumptions you tested, what the team shipped, what users did, and what you recommend changing next. Targets will be set after the baseline and delivery capacity are confirmed.

We are Paws & Co, the first veterinary brand in this region built to be loved, not just visited. We open in Dubai in December 2026 on a simple idea: pet parents deserve peace of mind, and vets deserve a place that protects them. One personalised membership built around each pet, a team that treats them like their own, and work that is about prevention and continuity, not one-off visits when something has already gone wrong. Care before commerce.




Technology is not a bolt-on for us, it is how the whole model works. The membership, the records, the booking, the telemedicine, the care plans: all of it runs on software we own. This is the senior pair of hands that builds it. Working with our CTO, you lead the day-to-day build, set the standard for the code that ships, and keep the whole thing moving as we scale across the GCC.




If you want to maintain someone else's stack, this is not it. If you want to build the thing itself, read on.




The role

You are the technical lead on the build. Hands on the keyboard, and leading from the front. You ship the website and the app yourself, you connect the systems that run the clinic, and you set the technical standard for everything the development pod puts out. The CTO owns the strategy and the roadmap. You own the architecture and turning it into working, reliable software, and we want to hear how you would build it. You use AI as a force multiplier across the whole stack, in the product and in how you work.




What you will do

• Lead the build of the website and CMS, kept fast, stable and well documented. You help choose the architecture, you do not inherit it.

• Build the app: pet health records, booking, telemedicine, vaccination tracking and personalised care plans, built in-house and owned by us.

• Integrate the clinical backbone: connect the practice management system, payments, memberships and the data flows that tie the clinic, the app and the member together.

• Uphold data protection and security to UAE PDPL standard. We hold sensitive medical and personal data, and it is handled properly, every time.

• Lead the development pod technically: set the standards, review what ships, and hold the quality bar alongside the CTO.

• Build AI into the product and the workflow: prompt engineering and AI-native development as part of how the product and the team work.

• Keep the whole system reliable and ready to scale as clinics multiply across the region.




What you bring

• Strong full-stack engineering across a modern web stack and relational data. You build and ship, you lead by doing, and you can justify the technical choices you make.

• Real experience integrating third-party systems and APIs: practice management, payments, authentication, the messy middle where systems have to talk.

• AI fluency is a must. You are comfortable with modern AI coding tools and prompt engineering, and you build AI into product and process. This is a hard requirement, not a nice to have.

• Sound instincts on data protection and security, and comfort working with regulated or sensitive data. Health data experience is a plus.

• Experience leading other developers or a pod, or briefing an agency, and holding a standard on what comes back.

• Product sense: you build for the person using it, not just the ticket.

• The temperament to lead a build: comfortable owning a lot, shipping fast, and keeping it stable while you do.




What we offer

• Above-market pay, and the chance to build the technical backbone from the ground up.

• Our wellbeing programme, the first in the region to take team mental health seriously.

• A real voice in the product and how it works, close to the CTO and the founding team, not layers away.

• A modern, AI-native way of working, and real ownership of the architecture and the tooling you choose.

• One percent of everything we make going back to animal welfare, through our Community Fund.




If you want to build the thing itself, come and build it with us.

 

About Paws & Co

Paws & Co is the first subscription-first veterinary brand in the region, opening in Dubai and scaling across the GCC and into Asia Pacific. 50+ clinics. One name. One standard. One promise. We are building the clinic pet parents deserve and the one the profession deserves at the same time: care before commerce, prevention over transactions, and vets who are supported, not squeezed. One percent of everything we make, our time and our product goes back to the animals who need it most. Founded by a team with a strong track record of building businesses in the UAE, and led clinically by Dr. Farah Murrani, with 25 years across the UAE, GCC, USA and South Africa.

𝗔𝗯𝘂 𝗗𝗵𝗮𝗯𝗶 (𝗨𝗔𝗘) · 𝗠𝗲𝗺𝗯𝗲𝗿 𝗼𝗳 𝗧𝗲𝗰𝗵𝗻𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗹 𝗦𝘁𝗮𝗳𝗳 · 𝗘𝗻𝗴𝗶𝗻𝗲𝗲𝗿 𝗜𝗜, 𝗟𝟰 · 𝗠𝗝𝗗𝟬𝟮.𝟭.𝟬

Hands-on engineer who prototypes, with product management and the 𝗱𝗼𝗺𝗮𝗶𝗻 𝗲𝘅𝗽𝗲𝗿𝘁𝘀, the first working way for 𝗔𝗜 𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗻𝘁𝘀 𝘁𝗵𝗮𝘁 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗿𝗼𝗹 𝘄𝗲𝗯 𝗯𝗿𝗼𝘄𝘀𝗲𝗿𝘀 through each legacy web application, and takes those applications apart to get there. Greenfield.




THE TECHNICAL CHALLENGE

We build agents on open-weight LLMs that operate web applications through the browser. The applications behave in ways no document describes. Sessions expire halfway through a form, buttons move, and one field means two things on two screens. The people who use them daily work around this, and an agent cannot. Product managers own the process and the requirement. This role builds the first working way through each application, alongside product management. It sits with the domain experts, records how they work, reproduces what misbehaves and finds out why. From that it builds the prototype that gets the agent through. What works goes into the product. What fails comes back as a test the agents must pass, with evidence. Progress is measured against benchmarked results.




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Build, in days and together with product management, the first working prototype of an agent operating a given application, and hand what works to the teams as components and tests

• Sit with domain experts, record how they operate their applications, and ask about what the recordings do not show

• Reproduce how those applications misbehave, diagnose the mechanism behind each fault from network, session and page evidence, and write it down so that others can reproduce it

• Break workflows down into states, decisions, exceptions and the ways they fail, and turn that into evaluation tasks, fault specifications for simulated applications and demonstration recordings




DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Has worked alongside expert users and product managers on behalf of an engineering or research team, and found what those users could not describe

• Has turned an undocumented human process into a specification that a team implemented and that ran in production

• Has built evaluation tasks or simulated environments from real workflows, or contributed to a test suite or benchmark for automation systems

• Arabic and English, spoken and written, for sessions with domain experts in both languages




EXPECTED QUALIFICATIONS

• T-shaped: deep in one domain, with working breadth in a neighbouring one

• Structures a large, incompletely specified problem and drives it to a working result independently; thinks in states, decisions and exceptions, and expects most of the work in the exceptions

• Patient and precise with people who have no documented process, runs sessions with non-technical experts and presents working demonstrations to them

• Has taken apart how third-party web applications behave (network logs, DevTools, screen recordings) and diagnosed failures to their mechanism; builds a working prototype against a real website in TypeScript or Python in days; uses AI coding tools daily and verifies their output




——




HOW WE WORK

• Product engineering: we own what we build and run it in production

• Small teams, two-week cycles, working software at every review

• AI coding tools are part of the standard workflow




WHAT WE OFFER

• Founding-team scope

• AI-augmented engineering environment

• Access to on-premise Nvidia B200s

• Flexible work environment




PROCESS

• Introductory call

• Technical conversation

• Practical session; the format is agreed with you




In coding exercises, AI tools are allowed and expected. No LeetCode.




WHO WE ARE

New product organisation as part of a large semi-government in Abu Dhabi. International, ex-FAANG team. Completely greenfield, with a modern tech stack.




——




REQUIREMENTS TO BE CONSIDERED

• Clear written and spoken English

• 3+ years in an engineering role with direct contact with the people who use what was built; own code operated in production

• Browser automation tools (Playwright or comparable) used against real third-party websites; TypeScript or Python

• Bachelor's degree in any field, or self-taught with a track record of open-source contributions




RELATED TECHNOLOGIES AND CONCEPTS

• Browser automation and computer use: Playwright, Chrome DevTools Protocol, Stagehand, Browser Use, Steel Browser

• Web application internals: sessions and cookies, authentication tokens, redirects, iframes, dynamic DOM, time-dependent responses

• Session capture and replay: rrweb, HAR, WARC, screen recording

• Evaluation: evaluation harnesses, trajectory evaluation, LLM-as-judge, Inspect, Langfuse; benchmarks such as Online-Mind2Web, WebArena, OSWorld

• Process analysis: task mining, process mining, cognitive task analysis, behaviour-driven specification (Gherkin), state machines

• Agent frameworks: OpenHands, SWE-agent, LangGraph, smolagents

• Models and infrastructure: open-weight LLMs, vLLM, SGLang, Kubernetes, TypeScript, Python

Global Commercial Services (GCS) serves millions of business customers around the world, from mom-and-pop shops to Fortune 500 companies. We back businesses so they can do more business, with a mission to be the undisputed leader in financial and membership services - responsibly driving double-digit revenue growth. We do that by offering a diverse range of payment and cashflow tools, from a wide range of traditional card products, to working capital and supply chain financing, to new digital solutions that make it easy for our customers to manage a full range of their financial and payment needs.

The Global Commercial Services team at American Express is seeking a Senior Software Engineer I with strong expertise in frontend development and user-centric product engineering. This role will play a key part in building a next-generation expense management platform that delivers intuitive, scalable, and high-performing digital experiences for Small and Medium-sized (SMS) businesses and Corporate customers.

Responsibilities


Lead the design, development, and deployment of modern web applications using React and TypeScript.
Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and stakeholders to shape product requirements and user experiences.
Build scalable, responsive, and accessible frontend architectures and component libraries.
Develop data-driven UI experiences, dashboards, and dynamic forms using JSON-schema or similar approaches.
Partner with backend engineers to integrate APIs and deliver seamless end-to-end functionality.
Mentor engineers and contribute to a strong culture of collaboration across teams and engineering guilds.
Integrate analytics, instrumentation, and observability into frontend applications.
Optimize performance, scalability, and reliability across browsers and devices.
Participate in architecture discussions, RFCs, and proof-of-concept initiatives.
Establish and maintain coding standards, testing practices, and design conventions.
Plan, estimate, and execute on deliverables while proactively identifying risks and resolving blockers.
Communicate progress and demonstrate milestones to stakeholders, incorporating feedback into iterative improvements.


Qualifications

QUALIFICATIONS


5+ years of experience in software engineering with a strong focus on frontend development.
Experience collaborating closely with product management and UX design teams.
Strong design sensibilities and a desire to build pixel perfect UI.
Strong communication, leadership, and mentoring skills.
Expert proficiency in React and Typescript.


Strong Hands-on Experience Building Modern Web Applications

Web: Next.js (App Router, RSC), React 19.

Mobile: React Native (Expo), React 19.

Monorepo : Turborepo

Data & state : TanStack Query (React Query) for server state, Zustand for client state, and tRPC for type-safe client-server contracts.

UI & design system : Tailwind CSS, class-variance-authority, and an internal component library; Framer Motion and react-reanimated for animation.

Observability & analytics : Datadog RUM and APM, Amplitude, FullStory .

Testing : Vitest for unit and integration tests; familiarity with component, visual, and end-to-end testing approaches.

CI/CD: Github Actions

Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the United States is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for this position.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer — AI-Driven Development (CTRM Platform)
queries: Full Stack Developer Node.js | Dubai, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
We build software by directing coding agents. Most of the code in this project is written by Claude Code. The engineer's job is everything that decides whether that code is correct: the architecture, the service boundaries, specifications precise enough to be implemented without guesswork, and review of every line that ships. We want engineers for whom AI-driven development is already the primary way they work — not a side experiment, not IDE autocomplete. We are explicitly not looking for vibe coders.

The product

We are building a new CTRM platform (Commodity Trading & Risk Management) for a physical oil-products trader: the full deal lifecycle from contract to settlement — pricing against market formulas, cost aggregation, invoicing, logistics, inventory, hedging.

Stack

Node.js and Python on the backend, React on the frontend, Postgres, Docker, CI/CD.

The role

You are an engineer, not an analyst. Business analysts own the process descriptions and hand you specified requirements. You own turning them into working software.

In practice that means: reading a specification closely enough to find the holes in it, deciding how it decomposes into services and data models, writing task briefs precise enough for an agent to implement, and then reviewing, testing and refactoring what comes back. You are the reviewer of record for everything you ship, regardless of who or what produced it.

You do need to understand what you are building. Not as a domain expert — but you cannot review a settlement calculation you don't follow, and you will be expected to ask the analyst the awkward question rather than implement an ambiguity.

Day to day


Design services, data models, APIs and transactional boundaries from specified requirements
Translate requirements into agent-executable task briefs — small enough to verify, large enough to be worth delegating
Own and evolve the project's agent context: `CLAUDE.md`, coding conventions, architectural guardrails, test policy
Review every diff seriously: data model, transaction and concurrency semantics, error handling, migrations, security, performance
Write and maintain tests that pin real behaviour — especially around money, rounding, dates, and state machines
Refactor aggressively when generated code is correct in isolation but wrong for the system
Ship in two-week sprints against a defined Definition of Ready and Definition of Done


What we expect


7+ years building and operating production backend systems
AI-driven development as your actual workflow.
You have shipped meaningful production features by directing coding agents, and can talk in detail about how you structure context, decompose tasks, control cost, and verify output
Domain modelling, relational data design, transaction and consistency semantics, idempotency, concurrency, API design, testing strategy, refactoring discipline. You can explain *why* a rule exists, not just that a linter enforces it
You can read, debug and reason about code you did not write — quickly, in an unfamiliar codebase
Strong Node.js and/or Python, solid SQL, comfortable with Docker and CI/CD
Willingness to engage with complex financial and logistics logic instead of routing around it
Strong Git, code review, and Agile delivery habits
Business proficiency in Russian language


How to apply

Share your CV plus an answer to two of the following questions:


Show us a real specification or task brief you wrote for a coding agent, and the code it produced. What did you change after review, and why?
Describe a time an agent produced code that passed its tests but was wrong. How did you catch it, and what did you change in your process afterwards?
What is in your `CLAUDE.md` (or equivalent agent rules file)? Pick three rules and explain why each is there.
Which parts of a system do you refuse to delegate to an agent, and why?


What we offer


A serious, unsolved domain problem rather than another CRUD product
Real autonomy over architecture and process, on a team that treats AI-driven engineering as a discipline to be built rather than a shortcut
Generous AI tooling budget — frontier models are a working expense, not a perk
Competitive compensation discussed individually

Role Overview




We are recruiting on behalf of an internationally recognised intelligence, information and technology organisation that combines deep domain expertise with cutting-edge software engineering to deliver market-leading digital products.




As a Senior Front End Engineer, you will join a collaborative product engineering team responsible for delivering customer-facing and internal platforms used by analysts and clients worldwide. You will play a key role in designing and developing intuitive, high-performance user experiences while contributing across the full software delivery lifecycle.




The team values engineers who are passionate about technology, enjoy working across different disciplines and can contribute beyond front end development. You'll collaborate closely with engineers, designers, business analysts and stakeholders to build secure, scalable and user-centric applications using modern technologies.




This role follows a hybrid working model, with two days per week in the Croydon office.




Skills Required

Strong commercial experience developing applications with React.
Experience building modern front end applications and user interfaces.
Exposure to Node.js and Express development.
Knowledge of JavaScript and modern web technologies.
Experience working across multiple technologies rather than specialising in a single framework.
Understanding of customer-facing web applications and digital products.
Experience working with databases such as DynamoDB and PostgreSQL.
Appreciation of UX principles and user-centred design practices.
Experience using design and collaboration tools such as Figma.
Strong testing mindset and focus on software quality.
Experience working within cloud-based environments, ideally AWS.
Ability to collaborate effectively within cross-functional engineering teams.
Comfortable owning solutions throughout the software delivery lifecycle.

Best of luck!

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Consultant
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
About The Job You Are Considering

Capgemini’s Insights & Data practice helps leading organizations harness data to drive innovation, efficiency, and transformation. With a focus on Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and emerging Agentic AI technologies, we help clients create intelligent solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to design, build, modernize, and support enterprise-grade digital platforms and mission-critical business applications. The role combines hands-on engineering with technical leadership across frontend, backend, integration, cloud-native deployment, and DevOps practices.

The successful candidate will translate business needs into secure, scalable solutions, establish reusable engineering standards, contribute to architecture governance, and mentor development teams throughout the software delivery lifecycle.

Your Role

Full Stack Engineering & Solution Design


Design, develop, test, and maintain secure, scalable, and highly available full stack applications.
Translate business and functional requirements into technical designs, architecture decisions, and delivery plans.
Build cloud-native solutions using microservices, stateless service patterns, containerization, and API-first principles.
Contribute to solution architecture reviews, technology selection, engineering standards, and platform roadmaps.
Remain hands-on in coding, troubleshooting, technical spikes, and resolution of complex production issues.


Frontend Engineering


Develop responsive Single Page Applications using Python, React, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern web standards.
Build reusable component libraries and design systems using tools such as Tailwind CSS, Radix, or ShadCN.
Implement role-based dashboards, accessible interfaces, reusable state and data-fetching patterns, and responsive workflows.
Optimize frontend performance, usability, maintainability, browser compatibility, and accessibility.


Backend, APIs & Workflow Automation


Design and develop backend services and microservices using Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, or NestJS.
Build REST and SOAP services, enterprise integration layers, background processing, and event-driven workflows.
Implement authentication, authorization, role-based access control, audit logging, idempotency, and exception handling.
Design configurable business workflows, approval processes, task orchestration, and regulatory process automation.


Enterprise Integration & Data


Integrate internal platforms, external service providers, and enterprise applications.
Implement synchronous and asynchronous integrations using REST, SOAP, or equivalent messaging technologies.
Design data models and persistence services using PostgreSQL, Snowflake, Oracle, MySQL, or equivalent relational databases.
Apply sound practices for transactions, data integrity, query optimization, integration resiliency, and failure recovery.
Have very good understanding of transaction and analytical data models.


Cloud, DevOps & Operational Excellence


Package and deploy applications using Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, and Helm.
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitLab, Jenkins, or equivalent platforms.
Implement structured logging, monitoring, alerting, health checks, and operational dashboards.
Improve release reliability through automated build, test, security scanning, deployment, and rollback practices.
Contribute to infrastructure automation and environment consistency using Infrastructure as Code where applicable.


Technical Leadership & Collaboration


Mentor engineers, conduct code and design reviews, and promote consistent software engineering practices.
Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, architects, QA, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and release teams.
Lead technical estimation, sprint planning, dependency management, risk resolution, and delivery governance.
Produce clear architecture decisions, technical documentation, API specifications, operational runbooks, and knowledge-transfer materials.


AI-Assisted Engineering


Use approved AI-assisted development tools to improve delivery productivity, documentation, testing, and code quality.
Establish governed AI-assisted workflows that retain human review, security, compliance, traceability, and intellectual property controls.
Assess emerging engineering tools and recommend practical adoption patterns aligned with enterprise standards.


Your Skills And Experience


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
Software engineering experience, and proven experience delivering full stack applications.
Proven delivery of enterprise-scale, high-availability, or mission-critical digital platforms.
Hands-on experience building cloud-native and microservices-based solutions.
Experience leading technical delivery, mentoring engineers, and working in Agile environments.
Strong problem-solving, stakeholder communication, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Must have experience with mobile application development and responsive application development.
Experience with content management systems is good to have.


Capability Expected experience

Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, SPA architecture, responsive UI, component-driven design

Backend: Java, Spring Boot, Spring Security, JPA/Hibernate, Node.js, NestJS or Express.js, microservices

APIs & Integration: REST, SOAP, API design, asynchronous messaging, event-driven architecture, IBM MQ or Oracle AQ

Data: PostgreSQL, Oracle or MySQL, relational modeling, SQL performance tuning, transaction management

Cloud & DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes or OpenShift, Helm, GitLab CI/CD or Jenkins, logging and monitoring

Engineering Practices: Git, code reviews, design patterns, automated testing, secure coding, Agile delivery, technical documentation

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs, and industry experts. We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible. It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.

By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering, and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. Make it real | www.capgemini.com.

jobs.description:
Atolls is the world’s largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets.

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you’ll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role:

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer (TypeScript, Next.js / Node.js) to join our Engineering team in Berlin or working remotely from Germany. At Atolls, your role will play a key role in helping us provide a seamless web experience that enables users to find the Smart Shopping capability that best matches their intent through search, navigation, and a personalized home page, creating exceptional user experiences and empowering consumers to make informed and confident shopping decisions. As a key part of our team, you’ll be directly involved in building and enhancing the digital destinations our users rely on throughout their shopping journeys.

Your contributions will help shape how millions of consumers interact with our platforms, guiding them to make smart, fair, and rewarding choices.

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect:


A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.
These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.



Responsibilities:

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will:


Design and develop modern architectures using NEXT.JS, AWS technologies, Microservices, NoSQL, and event-driven architectures.
Take ownership of solution architecture, improving performance, security, scalability, modularity, and operational efficiency.
Drive feature development from inception to delivery, contributing to an ambitious product roadmap.
Conduct knowledge-sharing sessions and hands-on exposure to emerging technologies.
Foster an open communication culture, encouraging feedback and supporting conflict resolution.



Your Profile:


6+ years of experience in software development.
Proficiency in Next.js / Node.js, with experience building reusable libraries using an atomic design system.
Strong foundation in object-oriented programming and concurrent event-based systems.
Advanced knowledge of TypeScript, including its environment and type system.
Extensive expertise in GraphQL.
Keen architectural mindset with an eye for application design patterns.
Excellent communication skills with fluency in English (written and spoken).



Desirable Skills:


Working knowledge of Apollo GraphQL.
Experience with PHP Symfony.
Experience working with AWS cloud.
Basic understanding of SQL databases and schema-less concepts.
Knowledge of E2E testing (e.g., WebdriverIO, Selenium, or similar tools).



Our hiring process:


TA Call: Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.
Technical Round: Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case), and meet your potential manager.
Final Round: Meet other Atollians 🏝️ It varies from 1 to 3 interviews
Some processes might slightly change according to needs



Ready to apply?

Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you’re welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster.

We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English.

At Atolls, we want to ensure that all employees can thrive in an inclusive environment. Our employment opportunities are open to every gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, ability, place of origin, or socioeconomic status. We remain committed to a culture of diversity, equity and belonging, where all employees are welcomed, respected, connected, and engaged.

As part of our recruitment process at Atolls, we use AI tools for interview recording and transcription. These tools are designed to assist our teams and are never used independently to make hiring decisions. Every assessment and hiring decision is made by our hiring panel and team through human judgment.

Before your first interview, you will receive an email with the option to opt out. You can also change your preference at any time during the recruitment process by using the link in that email or by contacting your Talent Acquisition Partner.

The use of AI, or the choice not to use it, will not affect your application in any way.

We are looking for a Solutions Architect – AI Factory with experience in designing, building, and maintaining large-scale AI factories to join our team at NVIDIA.

In this role, you’ll connect real-world customer workloads to NVIDIA’s hardware and software ecosystem, helping developers and enterprises adopt and scale our platforms. We’re looking for someone with strong technical depth who can serve as a trusted advisor, bridge complex challenges to innovative solutions, and grow into a strategic resource for the customers and partners you support. If you’re excited about applied technology and enabling others to succeed with advanced platforms, we’d love to hear from you.

What You'll Be Doing


Lead technical discovery with customer architects, engineers, and executives to understand business goals, AI/HPC workloads, performance requirements, security constraints, and deployment environments.
Design end-to-end AI Factory solutions spanning compute, networking, storage, cluster management, workload orchestration.
Guide customers through adoption of NVIDIA's full-stack platform.
Run proof-of-concepts, workshops, technical enablement, demos, and architecture solution reviews, that prove technical and business value and accelerate customer adoption.
Partner closely with sales account managers to shape technical strategy, qualify opportunities, develop solution proposals, and secure customer wins.
Lead technical design reviews, bills of materials, deployment plans, readiness assessments, and handoffs to implementation and operations teams.
Build and grow trusted technical relationships with engineers, architects, IT leaders, and executives at strategic customer accounts.


What We Need To See


BS, MS or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field (or equivalent experience).
5+ years in senior technical roles such as Solutions Architect, Systems Architect, AI/ML Platform Engineer, Technical Consultant, or similar.
Established track record designing, deploying, or operating AI and HPC infrastructure at enterprise scale.
Deep technical expertise in several of the following: datacenter infrastructure, distributed systems, high-performance networking, storage, cluster management, AI/HPC workload orchestration, and GPU-accelerated computing.
Experience leading technical discovery, architecture workshops, proof-of-concepts, performance validation, and executive-level technical presentations.
Effective collaboration across teams, combined with excellent written and verbal communication.


Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd


Strong experience working with enterprise customers across North Africa.
Native or fluent in Arabic and French, plus the ability to travel across North Africa as required (20% of the working time).
Practical background with the NVIDIA AI Factory stack.
Experience with MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing) systems used in AI Factory construction, including cooling infrastructure, power distribution, and plumbing systems.


If you're ready to take on this outstanding opportunity and help NVIDIA continue to lead the world in technology innovation, apply now!
