Job Summary

As a Forward Deployed AI Engineer, Technical Lead you set the technical direction for a squad embedded in the business: you sit with stakeholders to understand the problem and the why, then design, build, deploy and run the agentic AI systems that solve it, end to end. This is a hands-on, build-first role with single-threaded ownership of a real aviation outcome, working alongside a Business Product Owner and an AI Value Architect, on a shared platform (paved road, MCP fabric, standards) that lets your squad self-serve against Etihad’s systems.

Accountabilities & Responsibilities


Understand before you build. Start every problem with the business need and the why, working directly with stakeholders, then take the solution from discovery to production.
Design, build, deploy and continuously improve enterprise-grade agentic AI applications for real aviation scenarios, using agentic coding as your default way of working.
Build agents that reason across steps, call tools and APIs, manage context, handle exceptions and support human-in-the-loop, reliably and at enterprise scale.
Design and implement RAG pipelines over enterprise knowledge: ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval tuning, grounding and source traceability.
Build MCP-based integrations and connect agents to backend systems via REST/OpenAPI, webhooks and event-driven patterns with secure authentication, and expose your own work as clean, reusable, self-serviceable interfaces.
Apply structured LLM patterns end to end: tool calling, schema-validated outputs, retries, fallbacks and guardrails.
Own quality from day one: testing, evaluation, observability, logging, versioning and feedback loops for reliability, accuracy, latency, security and cost.
Apply security, privacy, access control, auditability, responsible-AI and governance across every deployment.
Take single-threaded ownership of a domain outcome (one owner, one result), and help establish reusable patterns that grow Etihad’s internal AI capability rather than renting it.
Coordinate with your Business Product Owner, AI Value Architect and other squads; speak up when AI is not the right tool.
Set the technical direction and standards for the squad’s agentic AI work, and make the key architecture and build-vs-buy calls.
Design multi-agent and agent-to-agent systems and the evaluation frameworks that keep them reliable, and lead delivery with external AI platforms and vendors while building Etihad’s internal capability.
Grow the engineers around you: mentor, review, and raise the bar on quality, security and cost across the squad.


Education & Experience


We look for a technical lead who sets the engineering direction for agentic AI while still building, and combines that with a business-first mindset:
Curiosity above all: you dig into problems, question assumptions and want to understand how the airline actually works.
A business-first, human-centric mindset: aviation is made for humans, by humans, and AI supports people, it does not replace them. Fluent English, comfortable in a culturally diverse, international team.
8+ years building production-grade software, including 4+ years with GenAI, LLMs and applied ML and at least 1 year of hands-on agentic AI as an early adopter, with a track record of setting technical direction and shipping agentic systems at scale.
Hands-on experience or strong working knowledge of MCP (Model Context Protocol) for connecting agents to tools, systems, APIs and data.
Strong Python, with strong knowledge of at least one of TypeScript / JavaScript, Java, or C#, and modern engineering practice: async programming, FastAPI, Pydantic, Git and CI/CD, testing, error handling and logging.
Practical experience with at least one agent framework or enterprise AI platform (e.g. LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, CrewAI, AutoGen, OpenAI Agents SDK, Microsoft Foundry, Amazon Bedrock
AgentCore, Google Vertex/Gemini) and with a vector database or search platform (e.g. Azure AI Search, pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, OpenSearch).
Experience integrating enterprise systems (APIs, managed identities, webhooks, queues, middleware) and deploying on cloud with containers, monitoring and observability; sound judgement on the trade-offs of latency, quality, cost and reliability, and on security, privacy, responsible AI and governance.
Strong assets: aviation or airline domain knowledge; a background in classical machine learning and data science; and classical full-stack development (interfaces, frontends, APIs, backend engineering).
Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience; relevant cloud-AI, GenAI, agentic-AI or MLOps certifications are an advantage.


Preferred For This Level


Experience building AI agents for complex enterprise or operations-heavy workflows (logistics, supply chain, aviation, cargo, customer operations or contact centre).
Experience with voice AI, email automation, CRM integrations, workflow automation or multilingual agents.
Experience designing golden test sets, simulation-based testing, regression testing and agent evaluation frameworks.
Experience designing multi-agent systems and agent-to-agent communication patterns, agent registries or tool-orchestration standards.
Experience leading delivery with external AI platforms, startups or vendors while building internal engineering capability.


Growth path: the natural next step is AI Value Architect, owning a cluster’s value journey while still building alongside the team.

jobs.description:
Who We Are

Flosum is a bootstrapped, profitable B2B SaaS company building the leading Salesforce-native DevSecOps, Data Protection, and Security platform. Our solutions are trusted by Fortune 500 enterprises in the most heavily regulated industries on the planet — financial services, healthcare, government, and insurance.

We're not a startup burning cash and chasing vanity metrics. We're a proven, scaling business that reached profitability on our own terms. As a Salesforce Summit Partner and Innovation Award winner, we've earned our seat at the table alongside the biggest names in enterprise software.

Built 100% on the Salesforce platform. Serving enterprises that demand zero compromise on security, compliance, and reliability.

Why This Role Exists

We are entering an aggressive growth phase — expanding our product surface, deepening our platform capabilities, and accelerating our delivery velocity. We need senior-caliber Node.js developers who can own significant parts of our architecture and ship production code that enterprise customers depend on daily.

This is not a staff augmentation seat. You will work directly with engineering leadership, product managers, and the CEO. Your decisions will have real consequences, your opinions will be heard, and your craftsmanship will be visible to the customers who rely on our platform.

What You'll Build


High-performance backend services and APIs powering enterprise-grade SaaS applications
Scalable, secure Node.js micro services and integrations within the Salesforce ecosystem
Modern front-end experiences using Vue.js and TypeScript that serve demanding enterprise users
CI/CD pipeline tooling, automation frameworks, and developer productivity infrastructure
Real-time data processing and event-driven architectures handling sensitive enterprise data at scale


Requirements

Read this section carefully. We are specific about what we need because we are serious about who we hire.

Non-Negotiable Technical Requirements


5+ years of professional Node.js development in production environments — not tutorials, not side projects, not bootcamp exercises. Real production systems serving real users at scale
Expert-level understanding of asynchronous programming, event loops, streams, and the Node.js runtime. You should be able to explain backpressure, the differences between setImmediate and process.nextTick, and why unhandled promise rejections are dangerous — without Googling it
Deep experience with TypeScript in production codebases. We write typed code, and we expect you to understand why
Strong command of RESTful API design, authentication patterns (OAuth 2.0, JWT), and API security best practices for enterprise environments
Proven experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, query optimization, data modeling, and understanding the performance implications of schema decisions at scale
Proficiency with Git workflows, code review practices, automated testing (unit, integration, and end-to-end), and CI/CD pipelines
Solid understanding of containerization (Docker), cloud services (AWS/GCP/Azure), and infrastructure-as-code principles


Highly Preferred (These Will Set You Apart)


Salesforce development experience: Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Visualforce, or Salesforce API integrations. If you know both Node.js and Salesforce, you are a rare and extremely valuable candidate to us
Experience building or contributing to Salesforce ISV (AppExchange) products
Vue.js front-end development experience, particularly with Vue 3 Composition API and state management
Experience working in B2B SaaS companies serving enterprise customers with strict compliance requirements (SOC 2, HIPAA, FedRAMP, GDPR)
Familiarity with DevOps/DevSecOps toolchains and practices in the Salesforce ecosystem


The Kind of Person We're Looking For

Skills get you in the door. Mindset determines whether you thrive here:

Missionary, Not Mercenary

You care about what you're building and why. You take ownership not because someone assigned it to you, but because that's who you are. When something is broken at 2 AM, you don't check whether it's "your responsibility" — you fix it.

Builder, Not a Bystander

You don't wait for perfect specifications. You dig in, ask hard questions, propose solutions, and ship. You would rather have a working prototype by Friday than a polished slide deck by next quarter.

Craftsperson Under Pressure

Enterprise customers depend on our uptime and data integrity. You write code that doesn't just work — it survives. You understand that in regulated industries, your code is your reputation.

Direct Communicator

You say what you think, respectfully and clearly. If a technical decision is wrong, you speak up — regardless of who made it. We value candor over politeness-at-the-expense-of-quality.

This Is a Long-Term Commitment

Let us be direct: we are not looking for contractors who jump between projects every few months. We are building a world-class engineering team, and we invest heavily in the people who join us. In return, we expect commitment.

This role is designed as a long-term, full-time engagement. You will grow with us. You will own systems end-to-end. You will see the direct impact of your work in how Fortune 500 companies build, protect, and deploy on Salesforce.

If you're looking for a short-term gig while you wait for something else, this isn't the role. If you want to build something that matters and be part of a team that's scaling from strong to dominant, keep reading.

Benefits

What We Offer


Competitive compensation commensurate with your experience and impact
Direct collaboration with the founding team and engineering leadership — your voice will carry weight from day one
A profitable, stable company with aggressive growth plans — no funding anxiety, no runway clock
The opportunity to work on enterprise-grade products used by some of the largest organizations in the world
Meaningful technical challenges: security, compliance, scale, and reliability at the intersection of Node.js and Salesforce
A culture that rewards ownership, speed, and craftsmanship over politics and hierarchy
Remote-first flexibility with a results-oriented work environment

jobs.description:
Property Finder is the leading property portal in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, dedicated to shaping an inclusive future for real estate while spearheading the region’s growing tech ecosystem. At its core is a clear and powerful purpose: To change living for good in the region.




Founded on the value of great ambitions, Property Finder connects millions of property seekers with thousands of real estate professionals every day. The platform offers a seamless and enriching experience, empowering both buyers and renters to make informed decisions. Since its inception in 2007, Property Finder has evolved into a trusted partner for developers, brokers, and home seekers. As a lighthouse tech company, it continues to create an environment where people can thrive and contribute meaningfully to the transformation of real estate in MENA.




Role Summary




We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the team behind the surfaces that bring millions of people to Property Finder every month — search, property and location content, and the platforms that serve them across multiple countries and languages.

This is high-traffic, consumer-facing, and unusually unforgiving: page latency, cache behaviour, and data correctness are not just engineering quality metrics here, they directly move organic acquisition and revenue. You'll work close to the numbers and see the impact of your decisions in production within days.

It's a hands-on senior role. You'll design and own services end to end, influence architecture beyond your squad, and raise the bar for the engineers around you.




Key Responsibilities




Design, build, and operate the backend services powering our highest-traffic consumer surfaces.
Own your work end to end: design, implementation, testing, deployment, observability, and the follow-up iteration based on what production actually tells you.
Build new services and features in TypeScript (Node.js), and maintain and evolve our existing Go services.
Work at the edges of the system — caching, CDN behaviour, content delivery, and rendering paths — where small changes have outsized effects on cost and performance.
Build for multiple countries and languages from day one: content, localisation, and market-specific behaviour are the default, not an afterthought.
Partner with product, SEO, data, and web/mobile engineers to turn requirements into systems that stay maintainable after the first release.
Drive operational excellence: monitoring, alerting, incident response, and continuous improvement of reliability, latency, and infrastructure cost.
Mentor engineers, review designs and PRs properly, and shape our backend standards.




Desired Qualifications




Must have 5+ years of backend engineering, with significant time on high-traffic, consumer-facing systems.
Strong TypeScript (Node.js) — the primary language for all new work.
Go, or a track record that says you'll pick it up fast. Our existing production services are in Go and you'll own them alongside new development.
Experience designing and operating services in a distributed environment: API design, service boundaries, versioning, and inter-service communication — plus the judgement to know when not to split something.
Hands-on with relational databases (MySQL/PostgreSQL), caching (Redis), and search (OpenSearch/Elasticsearch), including schema design, indexing, and query performance tuning under real load.
Production experience on AWS with containerised workloads, and genuine fluency in observability: metrics, structured logging, distributed tracing, SLOs, and being on the hook when something breaks.




Additional Capabilities




Event-driven and asynchronous processing (Kafka, SQS, or similar).
Edge computing and CDN-level logic (Lambda@Edge, CloudFront), and multi-region considerations.
Experience building for SEO-driven or organic-traffic-dependent products — you understand why crawlability, page performance, and structured data matter to a business.
Content platforms or headless CMS at scale.
AI/LLM features in production (AWS Bedrock or similar), including the latency and cost trade-offs of model calls on a user-facing path.
Marketplace, classifieds, or other two-sided platform products.




How You Work




You take ownership beyond your ticket — you notice problems, propose solutions, and follow through.
You explain technical trade-offs clearly to engineers and non-technical stakeholders, and you back your argument with data rather than preference.
You hold a high bar in code and design review, and the engineers around you get better for having worked with you.
You're pragmatic: you know when to build for scale and when to ship the simple thing, and you can quantify the cost of both.




Our promise to talent




At Property Finder, we believe talent thrives in an environment where you can be your best self. Where you are empowered to create, elevate, grow, and care. Our team is made up of the best and brightest, united by a shared ambition to change living for good in the region. We attract top talent who want to make an impact. We firmly believe that when our people grow, we all succeed.




Property Finder Guiding Principles




Think Future First
Data Beats Opinions, Speed Beats Perfection
Optimise for Impact
Act Like An Owner
The Biggest Risk is Taking no Risk at All




Find Us At

Facebook

jobs.title: Founding Growth Marketer
jobs.description:
Our vision

Short-term rental operators are drowning in scattered tools, missed guest messages, and manual work. We're building one system that runs it all — from guest communication and reservations to cleaning, maintenance, pricing, and reporting, powered by AI.

Base360.ai is on a mission to become the operating system that short-term rental businesses around the world run on. We help property managers automate operations, increase revenue, and scale their portfolios without growing their workload.

We're early, we're moving fast, and we're looking for people who want to help build something huge from the ground up.

About The Role

We're looking for a Founding Growth Marketer to help Base360 reach short-term rental operators and property management companies — and turn attention into demo bookings, qualified leads, and customers.

We're open to how you get there: you might go deep and own a single channel, or run across several. Paid ads, SEO, outbound, content, partnerships, lifecycle, funnels — we want someone who can find what works and make it grow.

This is a hands-on, entrepreneurial role. You'll work directly with the founder, experiment quickly, and build our growth engine from the ground up.

What You'll Do


Own a growth channel end to end — or run across several. Set the strategy, launch campaigns, and take responsibility for results.
Generate qualified leads and drive demo bookings. Build campaigns that reach short-term rental operators through paid ads, SEO, outbound, referrals, and industry partnerships.
Understand our customers. Learn how property managers operate, what slows them down, and what makes them switch software.
Run experiments fast. Test hooks, audiences, funnels, and offers; stop what doesn't work and scale what does.
Use AI wherever it gives you an edge. Apply it to research, copy, targeting, content production, and automation.
Build funnels and landing pages that convert. Improve each step from first impression to demo booking and paying customer.
Work closely with the founder on positioning and messaging. Turn product capabilities into clear reasons for operators to choose Base360.
Track performance. Measure lead quality, conversion rates, acquisition costs, and pipeline contribution — and explain what's working and why.


Who You Are


You're a fast learner. You may specialise in one growth channel or work across many, but you pick up new skills quickly and enjoy figuring things out.
You're hungry to get great at growth. You don't need to know everything yet, but you're determined to become one of the best.
You're AI-savvy. You use modern tools to test ideas, automate repetitive work, and move faster.
You're resourceful and self-directed. You take a goal and figure out how to achieve it without waiting for detailed instructions.
You're analytical. You're comfortable with data, attribution, and turning insight into action.
You care about commercial results. You measure success through qualified demand and customers, not just impressions and clicks.
Bonus: Hands-on experience with paid ads, SEO, outbound, content, lifecycle marketing, or partnerships.
Bonus: Experience in B2B SaaS, short-term rentals, hospitality technology, or marketing to property managers.


Why join Base360.ai?


Help build the AI operating system for short-term rental businesses.
Work directly with the founder and shape how we bring the product to market.
Have ownership from day one, with the opportunity to build and lead a growth team.
Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
Grow professionally in a hands-on, entrepreneurial environment where your work directly affects the business.


You Should NOT Apply If


You're looking for a predictable corporate role with a fixed playbook.
You engage in office politics or gossip instead of communicating directly.
You're looking for a slow-paced role with limited ownership.
You don't aim to become one of the best at what you do.

Think of it as founding a startup—with the advantage of funding, engineering, design, AI infrastructure, customers, distribution, and executive support already behind you.

If successful, you will become the long-term leader of your venture.

What You'll Do


Identify high-potential opportunities in short-term rentals that can become new products or business verticals.
Validate customer problems through research and direct conversations with property managers and rental operators.
Define the product vision, strategy, and go-to-market plan.
Work alongside engineering, product, design and AI teams to build and launch quickly.
Recruit and lead your own multidisciplinary team as the venture grows.
Own growth, product adoption, customer success and financial performance.
Make data-driven decisions and iterate rapidly based on customer feedback.
Present progress directly to the founders and executive team.
Build a business that could eventually operate as its own division—or even become an independent company.


What We're Looking For


Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias toward action.
Exceptional problem-solving ability.
Strong product and commercial intuition.
Comfortable working with ambiguity and creating structure where none exists.
Excellent communication and leadership skills.
Ability to recruit, inspire and lead high-performing teams.
Highly analytical with strong execution capabilities.
Obsession with customers and building products people love.
Comfortable wearing multiple hats across product, sales, marketing and operations.
AI-native and excited about building with the latest AI technologies.


Previous startup experience—as a founder, early employee, product leader, operator or investor—is highly valued but not required. Experience in short-term rentals, hospitality or property technology is a plus.

What Success Looks Like

Within Your First 12–24 Months, You Will Have


Built and launched a new business vertical serving the short-term rental industry.
Hired and led your own cross-functional team.
Achieved strong product-market fit.
Generated meaningful recurring revenue.
Established yourself as the long-term General Manager of your venture.


Why Join Base360.ai?


Be part of an innovative and fast-growing company building the AI operating system for short-term rental businesses.
Build your own venture with the backing of an experienced founding team.
Access world-class engineering, AI, product, design and go-to-market resources.
Receive funding, mentorship and strategic support to turn your vision into reality.
Opportunity to build a team and establish a long-term business within Base360.ai.
Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
Significant long-term career growth, with the opportunity to lead an entire business unit.


You Should NOT Apply If


You are looking for a corporate 9 to 5 job.
You are political and enjoy gossiping and talking about people behind their backs.
You are looking for a stable and slow dead-end job.
You do not aim to be one of the best in the world at what you do.

jobs.title: Deputy Chief Technology Officer - Trading Firm
queries: Next.js | United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
Deputy Chief Technology Officer - Trading Firm




Funding: Series C




About The Company

Since 2017, The Company has grown into a leading digital asset market maker and infrastructure provider. Today, our team of 200+ professionals across 42 nationalities powers trading on 80+ exchanges. Operating across Capital Markets and Asset & Wealth Management divisions, we combine algorithmic trading innovation (pioneering Rust in Web3) with institutional-grade financial services. Backed by our recent Series C, we are actively building the future of digital assets through organic innovation and strategic M&A.




Role Overview

The Deputy CTO partners with the CTO to lead the day-to-day operations of The Company’s global engineering organization. You will hold near-executive authority over engineering delivery, operational resilience, organizational health, and budget across all divisions. By connecting business strategy to world-class technical execution, you will ensure our high-frequency trading and asset management platforms scale reliably, freeing the CTO to focus on long-range AI transformation and external representation.




What Success Looks Like (12–18 Months)

Operational Excellence: A unified engineering cadence (OKRs, KPIs, delivery flow) is consistently adopted across divisions, enabling VPs to operate with high autonomy.
Platform Modernization: The multi-year trading platform consolidation transitions successfully from design to MVP with clear improvements in latency and deployment velocity.
Data Governance: A centralized, group-level data capability is live with a published catalog and cross-divisional SLAs.
Regulatory & Cost Control: Engineering consistently hits all MiCA, DORA, and SOC 2 milestones while managing cloud and vendor spend against clear business-unit baselines.




Key Responsibilities

Engineering Delivery & Cadence: Run day-to-day global engineering operations. Own OKRs, monthly business reviews, and delivery pipelines. Deputize for the CTO with the Board, ExCo, and external partners.
Platform Consolidation & Data Strategy: Lead the multi-year unification of The Company's trading infrastructure across 80+ venues and 1,400+ markets. Oversee the creation of shared group data pipelines and governance.
Cybersecurity Execution & Compliance: Own the on-the-ground execution of The Company’s security and regulatory commitments (MiCA, DORA, SOC 2). Foster a "controls-by-design" engineering culture while respecting regulated divisional information walls.
Talent, Budget & Scale: Manage the global engineering budget, vendor relationships, and M&A engineering integrations. Mentor divisional VPs, refine career frameworks, and scale the team across Europe and the US.




Core Competencies

Scale Operational Leadership: Proven ability to design and run engineering operating models (metrics, governance, delivery) for global teams.
Technical Depth & Decision-Making: Comfortable challenging senior architects on system design and making decisive, firm-wide trade-offs under constraints.
Executive Communication: Exceptional ability to translate complex technical risks, budgets, and timelines into crisp, actionable insights for ExCo and the Board.
Regulatory Execution Fluency: Expert at translating high-level security strategies into practical, everyday engineering workflows and compliance outcomes.




Key Experiences & Target Background

Trading & Crypto Infrastructure: Substantial experience with low-latency distributed systems, algorithmic trading infrastructure, and digital assets (CEX/DEX market structure, custody, on-chain settlement). Familiarity with Rust is a strong plus.
Multi-Division Scale & Consolidation: Proven track record running global engineering across multiple business lines, including executing large-scale platform consolidations and managing shared data/infra functions.
Regulated Environments: Experience operating within strict regulatory frameworks (MiCA, DORA, SOC 2) and managing engineering across compliance-driven information walls.
Operational #2 Profile: Prior experience as a trusted senior deputy or operational partner to a technical founder or CTO, taking true ownership of execution while strategy is held by the principal.
Growth & M&A Integration: Experience scaling engineering organizations through rapid maturity phases and integrating acquired technical teams.




What We Offer

We recognize that elite engineering leadership requires a world-class environment. As a key executive, this is a highly influential role where you will drive our overarching technology strategy, shape the engineering culture, and have the direct ability to make major company decisions.

To support your success, we offer a top-percentile compensation and benefits package designed for global leaders:

Financial & Equity

Competitive Base Salary: A highly attractive, top-market base salary reflective of elite engineering leadership in the proprietary trading and HFT space.
Stock Option Plan: Significant equity participation, giving you a vested stake in the long-term success and growth of the firm.
Performance Bonus: A highly lucrative, discretionary annual bonus structure tied directly to firm and individual impact.

Workplace Flexibility & Tech

Ultimate Working Flexibility: Choose the environment where you perform best, with fully remote, hybrid, or premium office-based options.
Global Mobility: The seamless ability to travel to, work from, and collaborate across our international office hubs.
Executive Tech Budget: A generous workplace and technology allowance to build a bespoke, ultra-high-end remote engineering and trading workstation.

Health, Culture & Lifestyle

Localized Statutory Care: Full statutory benefits, pension contributions, and leave entitlements tailored to maximize the standards of your country of residence.
Global Offsites: Fully funded company offsites and leadership retreats to foster strategic alignment and innovation.
Company Socials: Regular regional team events and socials to build deep relationships across our engineering and trading desks.

Our Interview Process

We respect your time and run a streamlined, transparent, and highly communicative hiring process. For this executive position, our process consists of:

Initial Discovery: An introductory call with our Senior Talent Partner to discuss your background, the role's scope, and mutual alignment.
Strategic & Technical Deep-Dive: A call with our CTO to discuss architectural philosophy, high-frequency infrastructure, and engineering leadership.
Executive Alignment: A comprehensive meeting with our Chief Executive team to focus on business strategy, firm vision, and cultural fit.
Presentation & Debrief: A final stage involving a presentation on a relevant technical or strategic topic, followed by an interactive debrief with our leadership.
Offer: Extension of a highly competitive offer to join the executive team.

Company Description SHOP ENHANCE GLOW, is a Dubai UAE-based online destination for premium beauty, skincare, haircare, grooming products, and professional beauty tools serving customers across the UAE and GCC. The company offers a curated portfolio of internationally recognized brands, including K-Beauty, salon-grade equipment, fragrances, and men’s grooming essentials. By partnering with trusted global manufacturers and distributors, SHOP ENHANCE GLOW ensures product authenticity and high quality. Through a seamless e-commerce platform, fast delivery, and customer-focused service, the team aims to provide an exceptional shopping experience for both individual consumers and beauty professionals. As the brand grows, it continues to expand partnerships with global beauty brands, salons, retailers, and distributors while strengthening its position as a trusted regional beauty and personal care destination.

Role Description The E-Commerce & Digital Marketing Executive is a full-time, on-site role based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. This role involves managing the online store, including product listings, pricing updates, stock checks, and coordination with operations for order fulfillment and delivery. The executive will plan and execute digital marketing campaigns across social media, email, and performance channels, optimize website content and user experience, and monitor analytics to improve traffic, conversions, and customer engagement. Daily tasks include handling customer inquiries related to online orders, collaborating with the design and content team on promotional materials, supporting sales initiatives, and maintaining brand consistency across all digital touchpoints. The role also requires staying updated on beauty and e-commerce trends to propose new initiatives that enhance revenue and customer loyalty.

Qualifications

Strong commerce and e-commerce operations skills, including online merchandising, basic pricing strategy, and familiarity with marketplace or e-store platforms.
Solid analytical skills to interpret website metrics, campaign performance, conversion data, and customer behavior, and to make data-driven recommendations.
Effective communication skills for coordinating with internal teams, external partners, and customers, and for producing clear marketing and product messaging.
Excellent customer service skills, with a focus on responsiveness, problem-solving, and maintaining a positive, professional brand image.
Sales-oriented mindset, with the ability to support promotional campaigns, upselling and cross-selling initiatives, and revenue growth objectives.
Experience with digital marketing tools (e.g., social media ads, email marketing platforms, Google Analytics or similar), and basic SEO knowledge.
Prior experience in e-commerce, beauty, cosmetics, or retail is highly desirable.
Diploma or bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Proficiency in English; knowledge of Arabic is an advantage.

Key Responsibilities:

E-Commerce Website / Shopify

Manage and update the Shopify website.
Create and optimize product listings, collections, pricing, offers, banners, and promotions.
Upload new products with accurate titles, descriptions, images, variants, SEO metadata, and specifications.
Monitor website performance, customer journey, and conversion opportunities.
Coordinate stock availability, pricing, promotions, and website merchandising.

Amazon & Marketplace Management

Manage Amazon UAE product listings and Seller Central operations.
Create and optimize product titles, bullet points, descriptions, keywords, images, and A+ Content.
Monitor listing health, suppressed listings, inventory, pricing, promotions, and account performance.
Experience with other UAE/GCC marketplaces will be an advantage.

Google Ads & Performance Marketing

Create, manage, and optimize Google Ads campaigns.
Experience with Performance Max, Shopping, Search, and Remarketing campaigns.
Monitor ROAS, conversions, CPA, CTR, CPC, and conversion value.
Work with Google Merchant Center and product feeds.
Identify underperforming campaigns/products and optimize budgets accordingly.

SEO

Perform keyword research and competitor analysis.
Optimize product pages, collection pages, titles, meta descriptions, URLs, and website content.
Improve organic rankings and website traffic.
Work with Google Search Console and Google Analytics.
Identify and resolve basic technical and on-page SEO issues.
Prepare monthly performance reports and recommend improvements.
Plan monthly content calendars.
Create and publish posts, Reels, Stories, offers, and promotional content.
Coordinate influencer collaborations and product campaigns.
Monitor engagement and social media performance.
Basic Canva/design and video-editing skills are preferred.

Candidate Requirements

Minimum 2–3 years of relevant e-commerce/digital marketing experience, preferably in the UAE.
Strong practical knowledge of Shopify.
Experience managing Amazon UAE / Amazon Seller Central.
Hands-on experience with Google Ads and Google Merchant Center.
Good understanding of SEO and Google Analytics.
Experience managing Instagram, Facebook and TikTok.
Strong product-listing and merchandising skills.
Basic graphic design/video editing knowledge is an advantage.
Experience in beauty, cosmetics, skincare, haircare, or personal care is highly preferred.
Must be organized, proactive, analytical, and capable of working independently.

Key KPIs

Performance will be measured based on:

Website sales and conversion rate
Google Ads ROAS and conversion value
Organic traffic and SEO ranking improvements
Amazon/marketplace sales growth
Product listing quality and accuracy
Social media engagement and traffic
Successful execution of promotions and campaigns

Preferred Candidate

We are particularly interested in a candidate who is hands-on rather than purely managerial — someone who can personally work on Shopify, Amazon listings, Google Ads, SEO, and social media instead of depending entirely on external agencies.

Candidates with previous experience working for a UAE e-commerce, beauty, cosmetics, fashion, or retail company will be given preference.

Job Requisition ID: 181509

About Al-Futtaim

Established in the 1930s, Al-Futtaim is one of the most diversified and progressive privately held regional businesses, headquartered in Dubai. Operating across more than 20 countries, the Group spans automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and health. With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Driven by its purpose to enrich lives and elevate communities, Al-Futtaim focuses on digital innovation, AI, sustainable growth and strategic partnerships, creating long-term value for customers, communities and partners while building a responsible legacy for future generations.

Overview Of The Role

Al-Futtaim Automotive is building a Creative Lab to shape how its digital experiences look, feel and perform across a diverse portfolio of automotive brands.

We are looking for a creative technology leader who can unite product design, generative AI, social-first content and experimentation. You will lead a multidisciplinary team delivering distinctive, accessible and measurable experiences across websites, apps, e-commerce, vehicle configurators, owners’ portals, WhatsApp, social media and employee-facing AI interfaces.

It is a hands-on leadership opportunity for someone who understands that great creative work must do more than look good. It must engage, convert, learn and improve.

What You Will Do


Lead the Creative Lab: Build and develop a multidisciplinary team spanning product design, research, creative technology, generative AI, social content and creative analytics. Strengthen in-house capability while managing agency and creator partnerships.
Build a multi-brand design system: Establish reusable components, design tokens and design-to-code standards that support distinctive English and Arabic experiences across web and mobile platforms.
Scale generative AI production: Develop production-grade workflows for copy, imagery, video, voice and personalized creative. Maintain robust controls for human review, OEM approvals, intellectual property, product accuracy, data privacy and brand safety.
Create social-first content: Use trends, social listening, creator partnerships and performance insights to produce culturally relevant content for platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels, Snapchat and YouTube Shorts.
Deliver personalized experiences: Turn customer segments and real-time signals into relevant content and interfaces across websites, apps, WhatsApp, email and other digital channels.
Make experimentation the default: Embed A/B and multivariate testing across interfaces, journeys and creative. Use evidence to improve conversion, engagement, usability, organic performance and cost efficiency.
Champion research and accessibility: Establish continuous customer research and ensure priority experiences meet WCAG 2.2 AA, Arabic and right-to-left requirements.


What You Will Bring


A Bachelor’s or master’s degree in human-Computer Interaction, Interaction Design, Digital Media, Creative Technology, Computer Science or a related discipline
12+ years of experience across UX/UI, product design and digital creative
5+ years leading multidisciplinary teams
Proven ownership of a multi-brand or multi-product design system in production
Experience scaling generative AI content pipelines, with measurable improvements in speed, cost or production capacity
A track record of social-first content with strong organic performance
Experience leading A/B or multivariate testing with measurable uplift
Experience delivering personalization across customer segments or channels
Strong knowledge of interaction design, customer research and accessibility
Experience designing and producing content for English and Arabic audiences
A portfolio linking creative decisions to customers, commercial or performance outcomes


Experience in automotive, e-commerce, consumer technology, media or telecommunications is preferred. GCC experience would be advantageous.

Technical Capabilities

Your technical experience should include several of the following:


Design systems, Figma, design tokens and Storybook
LLMs, diffusion models, generative image, video, voice and avatar workflows
Social listening, creator content, video production, and hook and retention analysis
Personalization and dynamic creative optimization
A/B and multivariate testing, statistical power and behavioral analytics
Usability research, WCAG 2.2, RTL design and Arabic typography
Motion design, conversational design or real-time 3D visualization


What Success Will Look Like


Distinctive and consistent experiences across the automotive brand portfolio
Improved customer usability, engagement and conversion
Faster and more cost-effective content production through generative AI
Stronger organic performance from social-first content
Increased adoption of reusable design-system components
More relevant, personalized customer experiences
Creative and interface decisions supported by controlled experimentation
Accessible experiences with strong Arabic and right-to-left parity
Robust brand-safety, intellectual-property and product-accuracy controls


Ready to build what comes next?

If your experience sits at the intersection of product design, generative AI, social culture and experimentation, we would like to hear from you. Show us the systems you built, the teams you led, the production workflows you scaled and the measurable impact of your creative decisions.

Join us in building a Creative Lab where every experience is distinctive, every asset is designed to perform and every idea has the opportunity to prove its impact.

Al-Futtaim Automotive is one of the region's leading mobility businesses, operating across eight countries in the Middle East, Asia and North Africa.

With a portfolio of more than 25 world-leading brands, we deliver one of the region's most comprehensive mobility ecosystems.

Our capabilities span passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles and industrial equipment, backed by integrated logistics, leasing, aftersales and financial services that deliver a seamless customer experience across every stage of the mobility journey.

Our vision is to become a world-class mobility player, creating better experiences for our customers through innovation, digital transformation and a relentless focus on customer experience. We work alongside some of the world's most trusted automotive brands to shape the future of mobility, delivering solutions that meet the evolving needs of individuals, businesses and communities.

Behind everything we do is a team of more than 9,000 colleagues united by ambition, collaboration and a shared commitment to progress. Together, we're shaping the future of mobility, embracing new technologies and creating better experiences for our customers. At Al-Futtaim Automotive, you'll be empowered to turn ambition into action and help move our customers, our business and your career forward.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Full-Stack, AI-Native), Senior-Level
jobs.description:
At Globant, we are working to make the world a better place, one step at a time. We enhance business development and enterprise solutions to prepare them for a digital future. With a diverse and talented team present in more than 30 countries, we are strategic partners to leading global companies in their business process transformation.

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (Full-Stack, AI-Native) who shares our passion for innovation and high-velocity engineering. Operating embedded alongside product teams in an AI-agentic delivery workflow, you will bridge technical decision-making with hands-on full-stack development making key architectural choices, validating AI-generated code, and shipping resilient .NET, React, and integrated solutions directly to production.


Role Summary



This role owns end-to-end delivery on a highly transactional booking platform serving 8 markets in 2 languages. You take features from technical solutioning to production across the full stack: React/TypeScript frontends, the .NET services and BFF, and the booking, payments and loyalty integrations underneath.

You work embedded with the Product team inside an agentic delivery workflow. By the time a feature reaches you, requirements and designs have already been analysed against the current codebase by AI agents, and you get a mapped impact and a set of implementation options with pros and cons. Your job is to challenge that analysis, make the final technical decision, and implement it across the stack yourself.

The role is hands-on and autonomous. You're expected to get productive quickly in an existing codebase, decide within your scope without waiting to be unblocked, and escalate only the decisions that really need it. Agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Codex, Copilot) are the default way of working. What we value most is judgement about when to trust, verify or rewrite what they produce.


Core Responsibilities



End-to-end technical solutioning


Review agent-generated impact analysis and solution options for each feature, validate them against the real codebase, and make the final technical decision with clear reasoning.
Own the solution design across frontend, BFF, backend services and integrations, including the trade-offs on performance, risk and delivery time.
Work directly with Product, Design and client stakeholders to clarify requirements, flag technical constraints early, and shape scope.



Full-stack development


Build and ship features across React/TypeScript frontends and .NET services and BFF.
Own integration contracts for booking, payments and loyalty, including failure handling, idempotency and retry behaviour on transactions.
Work with CMS-driven content (Strapi) and across web and mobile client surfaces.



AI-native delivery


Use agentic coding tools as the default mode for implementation, refactoring, test generation and codebase exploration.
Keep context artifacts current (repo conventions, agent instruction files, prompts and scripts) so the whole team and the agents work from the same foundation.
Help define the team's rules for AI-assisted work: what agents do, what they don't, and what must be human-verified before merge.



Quality and production ownership


Review PRs, human- and AI-authored, watching for hallucinated APIs, deprecated calls, hidden complexity on hot paths, and tests that assert nothing.
Take part in RCA on production failures and turn findings into fixes, logging and guardrails.
Act as a technical counterpart to the Technical Director, Product and QA, making decisions within your scope rather than escalating by default.
Tooling & Stack
Frontend: React
TypeScript
Flutter (mobile surface)
Backend: C# / .NET 8+
ASP.NET Core
REST APIs / BFF pattern
Redis
AI & agentic workflow: Claude Code
OpenAI Codex
GitHub Copilot
MCP servers
agent instruction files
Platform: Azure
Docker
GitHub Actions
ArgoCD
New Relic
Integrations: Checkout.com (payments, 3DS)
Strapi CMS
Experience & Skills



Must have

Join our game development team in Malta as Senior Fullstack/

Backend Engineer - Node.js/Typescript!




At Twin Harbour Interactive we strive to develop high-quality strategy games and make them accessible for all players around the world. In our eyes game development is a promise for fun and entertainment – that’s what we live and aim for!

Innovation is part of our DNA. We actively integrate Artificial Intelligence to reduce repetitive tasks and create space for what really matters: strategic thinking and human connection. We don't just use AI - we look for people who can shape the way we work with it.

As a Senior Fullstack/Backend Engineer - Node.js/Typescript, you will be responsible for designing, building, and enhancing features for our game platform, focusing on applications used by our game teams as a service that are interfacing with other internal and external services. In the beginning, you will work on extracting loosely coupled microservices out of our monolithic PHP application. The services will be running on a distributed architecture in the Google Cloud. Your work will align with best practices in stability, performance, scalability, security, and maintainability.

In this role, you will collaborate closely with game designers, producers, and other stakeholders to create innovative services that enhance the player experience and enable internal stakeholders to work more efficiently.

Please submit your resume outlining your relevant experience and why you are interested in joining Twin Harbour Interactive. We look forward to hearing form you!




YOUR MISSION

You will mainly work on extracting loosely coupled microservices written in Node.js/TypeScript out of our PHP monolith. However, you need to be comfortable with working in other languages like PHP as well.
Take ownership for maintaining and extending some of the central shared services that are used by game teams and other stakeholders like game design and monetization.
Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain, and improve our software with high-quality, maintainable code.
Define SLOs, add metrics/tracing/logging, participate in on-call/incident reviews, and continuously harden reliability & performance for live operations.
Leverage AI tools and technologies to enhance development efficiency, code quality, and problem-solving capabilities.
Work closely with game designers and product leads to implement new features with an interest in learning the complementary full-stack technologies.
Communicate and collaborate within a cross-functional team and with other teams to ensure a smooth daily workflow.
Actively bring in new ideas and participate in technical decisions influencing the architecture of our services and platform.
Drive initiatives to enhance the stability, performance, and scalability of our platform and live games.
Contribute high-quality, maintainable Typescript code using a wide range of technologies such as Next.js, Nest.js, Jest, Mocha, Turbopack, GitHub, Docker, MySQL, Pub/Sub and Redis.
Mentor engineers via design reviews, pairing, and by setting coding standards and contribute to engineering hiring.




YOUR BACKSTORY

Proven experience in Node.js/Typescript development, demonstrating strong coding and debugging skills.
Proficiency in popular Node.js/Typescript frameworks such as Next.js, Nest.js, Express.js, and Jest.
Deep experience with distributed systems: queues/pub-sub, idempotency, data modeling across service boundaries, and eventual consistency.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment.
Demonstrated ability to effectively integrate AI tools into development workflows for code generation, debugging, and technical research.
Be familiar with or eager to learn other languages like PHP or Java.
You have a proactive attitude towards learning new technologies and improving existing skills, including leaving the comfort zone of your programming language.
You have experience developing and maintaining multi-server, high-load backend services and APIs.
Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL databases, including MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, or similar.
Strong automated quality mindset using unit testing, integration testing, and other test automation frameworks.
You are enthusiastic about games and ideally strategy games.
Experience with cloud platforms (GCP preferred), networking, and debugging distributed systems is a plus.
Hands-on experience with agile methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban.




Why You'll Love Working With Us

A Global Team, A Shared Purpose

Our strength lies in our diversity. With over 30 nationalities represented across our two locations, we’re united by a shared passion for strategy games and a bold vision for the future. We celebrate what makes each of us unique – our perspectives, our stories, and the paths that led us here.

Work Your Way

Whether you're crafting code from a harbor-view desk in Hamburg or fine-tuning design details under the Maltese sun, we support flexible hybrid work models that empower you to do your best work – wherever you are.

Grow With Us

At Twin Harbour, your journey matters. Our Career Path Framework and mentorship culture provide the clarity and feedback you need to take the next step – whether you’re deepening your expertise or branching into new disciplines. We invest in your growth with language courses, e-learning platforms, and support for conferences and training.

We’re Human First

We believe that great teams are built on trust, respect, and good humor. From game nights to casual drinks, quiz nights, and karaoke, we don’t just work together – we connect, play, and support each other like a true crew.




Join Twin Harbour Interactive

Where Strategy Meets Vision.

Twin Harbour Interactive is a global strategy game powerhouse, shaping the future of long-term multiplayer gaming. With offices in Hamburg and Malta, we design strategy games that bring people together – across borders and generations.

Whether you’re an expert tactician or an imaginative world-builder, there’s a place here for you to grow, thrive, and leave your mark.

jobs.description:
About Electricity Maps

Electricity Maps is a VC-backed climate and energy tech start-up building the world's most comprehensive electricity data platform. We provide real-time, historical, and forecasted data on electricity systems worldwide - covering generation mix, electricity prices, carbon intensity, and renewable share.

Our data powers decisions across sustainability and energy markets: from companies like Google and Cisco optimising compute workloads and reporting emissions, to energy market participants using our forecasts to inform trading strategies and asset optimisation. We're a small, technical team based in Copenhagen, working at the intersection of energy, AI, climate change, and data.

About The Role

You'll work in the product team responsible for exposing our data to the world and you will help people and companies consume our data: Via our API, our map or whatever makes sense next.

We believe in engineers owning product decisions. Engineers scope the problem, build it and evolve it based on feedback from customers, colleagues and users. Those decisions usually aren't mapped out before you start on them so you're figuring out the shape of the problem and the best solution as you unpack it.

You'll be part of a small engineering team with 3 other full-stack engineers. No two days look the same. Most of your energy goes into building and figuring out solutions, with bug fixes and other tasks mixed in.

What you'll do


Build and ship across the stack (we’re using TypeScript for 95% of the product surface).
Own the systems that touch customers directly, from how we onboard, guide and support them to how we serve data in the API they integrate with.
Decide what to build in collaboration with leadership, sales, marketing and data teams.
Care about your solutions being actually used and understand what matters to our users: dig deeper in analytics, join commercial conversations, be curious.
Push on new ways customers can interact with our data. Maybe new API capabilities, new functionality in the map or something else.
Dig into bugs and edge cases.


What you won't do


Ship something and never find out if anyone uses it.
Wait around for permission to fix something you can see is broken.
Spend more time in alignment meetings than building.


What we're looking for


6+ years of hands-on experience shipping full-stack features in production and scaling them.
Early-stage tech company / product experience.
Product mindset, meaning that you build with the user in mind and have strong, defensible opinions on what "good" looks like; in code, in product, in process.
Comfortable with data-heavy products, where edge cases and correctness can play a big part.
Founder mentality, meaning that you are excited about building new products and taking them from an early stage to something users rely on. You spend time across the organization to deepen your knowledge and learn how users interact with the product to build things that are used.


Our stack

Relevant to this role: TypeScript, Node.js, React, GCP. The ideal candidate has worked in or close to these systems.

The details

Location: Copenhagen (office first, with flexibility)

Type: Full-time

Compensation: Competitive salary + stock options

Benefits: 6 weeks vacation, health insurance, annual company offsite, lunch and snacks at the office

Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.

Le contexte

La squad Productivity est au cœur de la transformation produit autour de la gestion des affaires contentieuses de bout en bout.

Le scope de la squad s'est considérablement enrichi, au-delà du seul gain de productivité, en allant vers l'accompagnement de la réflexion et de l'argumentation juridique, à travers plusieurs langues.

Aujourd’hui, elle est responsable de toute la chaîne de valeur :


Analyse de documents
Rédaction automatisée des conclusions et documents juridiques
Réflexion stratégique sur l’argumentation


C’est le cœur de notre IA appliquée au raisonnement juridique : travail avancé sur les modèles LLM, le machine learning et la structuration de documents complexes.1.

Tu peux trouver des détails sur l’ensemble de la stack sur Github !

A savoir : il n’est pas nécessaire d’avoir une expérience professionnelle dans le domaine du droit, cependant l’envie de s’investir et de monter en compétence dans la compréhension des documents juridique est importante :)

Les missions 🛠


Concevoir et développer des features produit de bout en bout — de la modélisation back-end à l'interface utilisateur, en ownership complet sur tes sujets.
Intégrer des modèles d'IA et LLM dans les flux produit — pour enrichir l'expérience des avocats et juristes qui utilisent Doctrine au quotidien.
Maintenir et faire évoluer notre architecture cloud — stack moderne, scalabilité, fiabilité des services en production.
Participer activement aux choix techniques de ta squad — revues de code, décisions d'architecture, amélioration continue de la qualité du code.

Les à côtés du poste 👁

Nos valeurs 🤝

Notre processus de recrutement 🚀

The Mendix Developer – Web designs, builds, and maintains high-quality enterprise web applications on the Mendix low-code platform. Key Responsibilities

Application Development & Architecture

Design, build, and deploy Mendix web applications using best-practice architecture and development patterns.
Translate business requirements into scalable, maintainable, high-quality Mendix solutions.
Develop complex domain models, microflows, nanoflows, workflows, and responsive UI components (Atlas UI, page templates, custom widgets).
Build custom components using Java and JavaScript actions written to company conventions and best practices.
Design and implement robust Mendix security models (user roles, module roles, entity/page/microflow access) strictly following the principle of least privilege.
Ensure application performance, scalability, reliability, and compliance with enterprise standards.
Conduct thorough code reviews to enforce quality, consistency, and maintainability.
Implement auditing, logging, and monitoring while championing DevOps, BizDevOps, and SecDevOps principles.

Design highly modular, reusable components (modules, microflows, nanoflows, snippets, document templates) and work with Mendix Building Blocks.
Collaborate with enterprise architects, infrastructure teams, and system owners to align solutions with the broader IT landscape.
Maintain strong documentation discipline: clean code, in-app documentation, and complete handover deliverables (LLD, API documentation).

Technical Skills

Strong Java and JavaScript proficiency for custom actions, debugging, and performance optimization.
Strong experience with REST/SOAP web services, API design, and API documentation.
Advanced SQL skills: complex queries, joins, and indexing.
Experience with Git-based development, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployments; performed multiple Mendix major upgrades.
Hands-on experience with on-premise environments; solid understanding of networking, certificates, firewalls, and proxy configurations.
Proficient in leveraging AI tools (e.g., Copilot, ChatGPT) to accelerate development, debugging, and documentation.

Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, particularly for complex integration and performance issues under tight deadlines, while remaining calm and positive during high-pressure situations.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to write clear, professional client emails and documentation and conduct client-facing discussions.
Strong stakeholder-management and facilitation skills for workshops and requirement sessions.
Comfortable in agile/scaled-agile and waterfall environments; adept at managing scope, bridging customer expectations, and enforcing process in structured deliveries.
Highly proactive: identifies blockers, proposes solutions, and drives initiatives when progress slows or new opportunities arise.
Proven ability to work independently while leading technical workstreams.

jobs.description:

Flexible, hybrid Sydney based role - 3 days in office
No technical debt! Come and do your best work with interesting tech




About Settify

Settify, an AI-backed technology, helps legal clients in preparing and presenting their personal stories effectively. It streamlines the initial information-gathering process, helping clients articulate key details when seeking legal assistance, particularly in areas like family law and wills. Collecting new client information can involve significant time and cost spent on both sides. Using Settify saves time, increases the accuracy of their work and ultimately, helps their clients by reducing their costs and increases their chance of success in their matters.

Settify is a member of the LEAP group of companies - the leading provider of Legal Practice Management Solutions in the world. Over a 30-year period we've expanded across Australia, Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, the Republic of Ireland, Poland and New Zealand and support more than 70,000 lawyers and their staff in small and medium sized law firms. We owe our success to our curiosity and commitment to our guiding purpose, to 'Help lawyers who help people'.




What you'll do

As a pivotal member of the team, you'll help shape the development of an AI-driven legal product that provides users with intelligent tools for managing their legal information. You'll be instrumental in rebuilding the entire application from the ground up, making it fully customisable and content-driven to streamline legal client intake and case preparation.

This will involve integrating advanced AI features to enhance the product's intelligence and user experience.

To make this happen you will:

Help design and implement the product architecture.
Collaborate with team members to re-build the application using TypeScript.
Design and ship AI features - prompts, evals, tool-use, agent flows - that genuinely change what the product can do for users.
Own meaningful slices of the product end-to-end - you'll make the calls, ship the work, and live with the results.
Work closely with the leadership team and our team of legal experts.




What you'll bring

8+ years building and shipping full-stack web products in production - ideally including at least one you took from zero to users.
A track record of accomplishments you're proud of - hard problems solved, products shipped.
Deep proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js and modern web development frameworks.
Strong data modelling instincts - you've designed schemas that survived contact with real users and changing requirements, not just queried existing ones.
A CS or engineering degree, or the equivalent depth picked up by building things - we care about how you think, not where you learned it.
Hands-on experience integrating LLMs into a product - prompts, evals, tool use, or agent flows. You don't need to have trained a model, but you should know what works and what doesn't in production.




Even better if you have;

Worked on a greenfield project or in an early-stage team, and know the difference between 'scrappy' and 'sloppy'.
Exposure to legal tech, SaaS products, or early-stage tech teams.
An interest in machine learning and building new AI models.




You are the type of person who embodies these traits

Communication. You're concise in speech and writing, and you collaborate openly and positively.
Motivation. You're driven to make a real difference through your work, and find genuine joy in seeing users benefit from what you create.
Pragmatic. You understand the trade-offs between quality and velocity, and consistently strike the right balance.
Curiosity. You constantly ask who, what, where, when and why, seeking deeper understanding and better solutions.

Settify is an inclusive, people-first company committed to breaking down institutional barriers that keep people from reaching their potential. If you meet some, but not all the requirements above, we encourage you to still submit your application.




Why join Settify?

Your work matters. Helping lawyers help people sits at the heart of everything we do. We solve real world problems that improve and support local, everyday law firms. So they can do their best work for the people in the communities they serve.
Make an impact. You won't be another ‘cog in the wheel' here. We give full trust and autonomy for you to be heard, to work on big & complex projects - and to make a real difference.
Work with a group of authentic, passionate people who love what they do.
Well-funded and global. We're part of ATI - one of the largest international LegalTech companies.
Flexible and hybrid working. We'd like to find this person in Sydney, but we want you to work in a way that suits you and we're open to flexible arrangements that support you.
Grow your career with us. Our founder Christian Beck has been building legal tech businesses for over 30 years. There are opportunities galore to expand your career based on where your interests lie. We're not afraid to pivot based on market conditions - you will always have the opportunity to stay ahead of the curve and do your best work here.
Have fun with us. Celebrations. Socials. Sports teams. Access to sailing and yacht events.
We value your well-being - enjoy 2 additional paid wellbeing days every year, free gym membership, corporate dental plan and weekly massages in the office.
Work in a beautiful office space - with a catered lunch and breakfast every week and a fully stocked kitchen
Access to LEAP Home - a program unique to ATI to support you in buying your primary residence.

Integrity - People demonstrating this competency are open & honest in everything they do. They support financially & environmentally sustainable growth. They make socially responsible decisions and treat their stakeholders with respect.

IHS is committed to improving the quality and availability of telecommunications infrastructure, the lifeline for an increasingly connected world. About AI71

AI71 builds enterprise-grade AI and data platform software for organisations operating in regulated, mission-critical environments.

Our solutions are delivered in two deployment modes:


Managed SaaS — multi-tenant, cloud-hosted, continuously updated.
On-premises — single-tenant installs in customer data centres, including fully disconnected and air-gapped environments.


Quality engineering at AI71 means proving that releases behave correctly in the cloud and behind a firewall, including fully disconnected, air-gapped installs where a shipped defect can't be quietly patched the next day.

The Mission

As a Lead / Staff QA Engineer you set the quality strategy and testing architecture for AI71's platform. You own test architecture and release-quality standards across both SaaS and on-prem operating models, mentor QA engineers across teams, and drive multi-quarter quality strategy. You are a force multiplier.

Key Responsibilities


Define test architecture and quality standards across the platform (test pyramid, automation strategy, release gates).
Lead major decisions on test tooling, automation investment, and release-quality processes.
Mentor senior QA engineers; raise the quality bar across multiple teams.
Drive cross-team initiatives that reduce defect escape rate and improve release confidence.
Partner with engineering and product leadership on multi-quarter quality strategy.
Own the release sign-off process, including for fully air-gapped / on-prem release candidates.
Ensure quality practices scale across managed SaaS and disconnected on-prem deployments.


What You’ll Bring


10+ years of QA, test engineering, or quality architecture with a history of architectural ownership.
At least 2 years focused on testing complex data-driven applications, ML models, or AI agents.
Proven track record designing test architecture and quality processes at scale.
Expert proficiency in Python (Pytest) and standard libraries (Selenium/Playwright, Requests).
Mentorship record — engineers you have grown now operate independently at higher levels.
Track record of leading major quality initiatives end-to-end.
Deep comfort architecting test strategy for systems that run in both managed SaaS and on-premises / disconnected air-gapped environments.


Nice to have


Conference speaking, technical writing, or industry thought leadership.
Open-source test tooling contributions.
Arabic language skills.


Why AI71?


Final Line of Defence: You define whether an AI agent is "trusted" to negotiate a contract or design a critical system component in a safety-critical environment.
Tax-Free Compensation: A market-leading, 100% tax-free salary and benefits package.
Full Relocation Support: Comprehensive assistance including flights, housing support, and visa sponsorship for you and your family to Abu Dhabi.
