The Institute

Technology Innovation Institute (TII) a publicly funded research institute based in Abu Dhabi, the United Arab Emirates. It is home to a diverse community of leading scientists, engineers, mathematicians, and researchers from across the globe, transforming problems and roadblocks into pioneering research and technology prototypes that help move society ahead.




Propulsion and Space Research Centre

The digital engineering team within TII’s Propulsion & Space Research Centre develops software and engineering capabilities supporting propulsion and flight-vehicle research programmes.

Current capabilities include an operational engineering platform supporting requirements and system models, test campaigns and results, risk and evidence registers, and interactive 3D visualization; validated physics and gas-turbine simulation software; an AI engineering assistant grounded in live platform data and operating on local infrastructure; and a growing hardware capability spanning data acquisition, engine telemetry and hardware-in-the-loop testing.

The platform is already operational within an existing deployment. The team’s next phase is focused on establishing product-line standards, enabling versioned components, repeatable releases, multiple deployments and reliable engineering evidence outputs, with the longer-term ambition of developing a commercial-grade offering.

The team operates with direct communication, short decision paths and high individual ownership. Software is developed against real engineering models, test-bench hardware and campaign data, with physics models serving as the technical source of truth.




Role Purpose

The Senior Software Engineer – Simulation & Engineering Products will play a key role in developing and productizing the software backbone supporting propulsion and flight-vehicle research programmes within TII’s Propulsion & Space Research Centre.

The role sits within a small digital engineering team responsible for an operational engineering platform, physics-based simulation software, AI-enabled engineering tools, and an expanding hardware and test integration capability.

The successful candidate will be responsible for evolving these capabilities from programme-specific solutions into robust, maintainable and reusable software products built to product-line and commercial-grade standards. This includes establishing repeatable releases, versioned components, reliable deployment processes, stable APIs, test-evidence pipelines, and software that can support multiple programmes and future external applications.




Key Responsibilities

Software Product Engineering

Evolve the existing engineering platform from a single-deployment system into a configurable, maintainable and reusable product capable of supporting multiple programmes and, in the future, external customers.
Develop and enhance backend and frontend capabilities using technologies including Python/FastAPI and React.
Support platform capabilities covering requirements and system models, including SysML v2, test campaigns and results, risk and evidence registers, and interactive 3D visualization.
Improve overall product quality, including frontend experience, documentation, installation, upgrades, maintainability and security hardening.
Apply a strong product mindset to software architecture and development, considering users, roadmaps, maintainability and total cost of ownership.

CI/CD & Release Engineering

Own and enhance CI/CD and release-engineering practices across the product.
Develop automated build, test and deployment pipelines and comprehensive regression suites.
Establish reliable versioning and release-management practices.
Implement containerized deployments suitable for standard, offline and restricted-network environments.
Develop deployment documentation, operational runbooks and repeatable installation and upgrade processes.
Ensure releases are reliable, controlled and reproducible across deployments.

Numerical & Simulation Software

Support the engineering of physics-based software used as the technical source of truth, including:
Validated gas-turbine performance solvers.
Engine model adaptation using test data.
Compiled real-time engine models.
Extract existing model-adaptation and model-test correlation capabilities into independently versioned libraries with stable APIs.
Enable numerical libraries to be consumed through the platform backend, command-line interfaces and future engineering tools.
Apply appropriate software-engineering practices around scientific and numerical code, including tolerance-based testing, units management and floating-point considerations.
Work closely with physics and model-development specialists to ensure numerical models are integrated and used appropriately.

Test Data & Engineering Evidence

Design and develop pipelines for ingesting engineering and test data using formats including TDMS and HDF5.
Implement physics-based consistency and validation checks.
Develop traceable and reviewable engineering evidence outputs and reports.
Ensure test results and supporting evidence can be reliably linked to engineering models, requirements and programme activities.

Hardware & Real-Time Integration

Support software integration at the hardware boundary, including data acquisition systems, engine telemetry and real-time targets.
Contribute to the development and integration of a real-time hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) test capability.
Support high-rate data logging, time synchronization and reliable data transfer between acquisition systems, real-time systems and the engineering platform.

Engineering Quality & Collaboration

Act as a senior technical reviewer for software, architecture and engineering designs.
Conduct high-quality code reviews, identifying defects, maintainability concerns and opportunities for improvement.
Work closely with the platform’s Lead Engineer and other technical specialists within a small, highly autonomous engineering team.
Contribute to establishing and maintaining software-engineering standards across the team.
Use AI-assisted development tools where appropriate while maintaining robust human review, testing and evaluation controls.

Research & Publication

Contribute to research and technical publications where the work presents publishable outcomes.
Potential research areas include test-driven model adaptation, evaluation of grounded AI engineering assistants, and test-data engineering.




Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Advanced academic qualifications in a relevant engineering or scientific discipline would be advantageous.




Experience

Minimum 7 years of experience building and shipping production-grade software.
Demonstrated experience working with numerical, scientific, simulation or engineering software in domains such as aerospace, energy, automotive, scientific computing or quantitative finance.
Proven experience owning software through the full development lifecycle, including deployment, operation, maintenance and support.
Demonstrated experience shipping a software product, application, library or engineering tool through controlled and versioned releases.
Experience making and managing API decisions, breaking changes, upgrade paths, bug fixes and ongoing product maintenance.
Strong experience with CI/CD, DevOps, containerization, environment management, configuration management and release engineering.




Technical Competencies

Strong proficiency in Python.
Strong full-stack software-development capability.
Experience developing backend services using FastAPI, Django, Node.js, .NET, or comparable technologies.
Experience with modern frontend frameworks such as React or Angular.
Strong understanding of API design and user experience.
Comfortable working alongside C/C++ codebases.
Ability to understand and work with MATLAB or Fortran code wher

Job Description

Job Title: Solutions Engineer

Group: Solutions Engineering Team

Location: UAE

Company Overview

Quvia is the first AI-powered quality of experience (QoE) management platform for things that move, like ships and planes, transforming connectivity and digital experiences even in the most remote and hard-to-reach places. The Quvia platform uses AI and machine learning to seamlessly blend any combination of connectivity, regardless of provider, orbit or network, into one, vendor-neutral environment. It then delivers comprehensive, end-to-end analytics and dynamic network orchestration that optimizes for the best possible QoE and end-user experiences. Today, Quvia works with world-leading, Fortune 500 companies in aviation, cruise, shipping and more.

Why Quvia?


Founded in 2019, Quvia is a fast-growing, Series A tech startup passionate about making connectivity and digital experiences better for everyone, everywhere.
Our industry-first solutions are already addressing major challenges for companies in the aviation and cruise industries – and we're just getting started.
Quvia is headquartered in the greater Miami region, with offices in the UK and India, and remote teams around the world.
As an early-stage company, all Quvia employees have the opportunity to make a significant impact on our growth trajectory, and the future of the industries we serve.
Quvia is backed by Columbia Capital, a respected venture capital firm founded in 1989 that has raised over $5 Bn of fund commitments.


About The Role

The Solutions Engineer is the technical bridge between our customers and our engineering and operations teams, assessing a customer's current network, capturing new technical requirements and pain points, and converting them into solution designs that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will own the journey from qualification through proof of concept to production. This role demands deep networking fundamentals across terrestrial and satellite environments, hands-on expertise in software-defined networking (SDN) and multi-vendor SD-WAN technologies, scripting and DevOps capability, and the judgement to evaluate emerging technologies and design solutions that scale.

Working on this technology, you will have the opportunity to make a major impact on the implementation and quality of Quvia's next-generation products. Our environment cultivates innovation and rapid product iteration within a creative solution space, and we need a dedicated, organized, and efficient professional who thrives on being integral to a fast-paced startup. As an excellent communicator, you will set appropriate expectations, keep stakeholders apprised of progress and action items, manage project plans, balance workloads, and ensure we meet our commitments; all while navigating the complexities of large enterprise customers. Above all, you will think creatively through complex problems and design and implement solutions that address customer pain points and generate economic benefits, enabling us to publish a clear ROI for every customer.

What You’ll Do


Partner with sales to assess a customer’s current network, capture new technical requirements and pain points, and convert them into tailored solution designs with clear, measurable business outcomes.
Design, test and deploy multi path traffic orchestration systems across satellite, and terrestrial environments in customer networks using Quvia products and third party integrations. This will require the setup of a customer profile at edge, cloud and datacenters/POPs.
Lead proof of concepts end to end: define success criteria, design, hardware specifications, installation, configuration and testing of Quvia systems. Responsible for troubleshooting complex issues with customer, QA and Engineering teams, and own the handoff from POC to production.
Use scripting and DevOps practices to streamline solution delivery – configuration templating, workflow automation and tooling that supports demos, POCs and repeatable deployments.
Act as a technical advisor to customers, offering guidance on best practices and optimal usage of terrestrial and satellite communication systems, and presenting status updates and health metrics to customer stakeholders.
Conduct training sessions and workshops for customers and internal teams on the operation and maintenance of Quvia products and their value proposition.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including sales, product management, systems, engineering, QA, and service delivery, to ensure successful project execution. Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for all solutions and services provided. Complete a successful handoff to all relevant teams at the end of the project.


What You'll Need


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science, or a related field.
At least 5 years of network engineering experience across terrestrial and/or satellite communications, including multi-link architecture.
Deep networking fundamentals, including routing and switching, network security, wireless, and datacenter networking.
Hands-on experience with software-defined networking (SDN) and multi-vendor SD-WAN and Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW) platforms such as Fortinet, VMware VeloCloud, Cisco (Meraki/Viptela), Cradlepoint (Ericsson), Palo Alto, or similar enterprise solutions.
Scripting and DevOps experience in a networking context – Python, REST APIs, configuration orchestration, zero-touch provisioning and workflow automation.
A track record of leading customer-facing POCs, deployments or migrations (for example, from traditional WAN architectures to SD-WAN) in large enterprise environments.
Proven ability to convert a customer’s current network, new technical requirements and pain points into business outcomes, and to articulate that value to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Proven knowledge and understanding of managing virtual infrastructure using VMware vSphere, Hyper-V, or KVM, and a thorough understanding of computer hardware and operating systems.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to lead customer conversations at both engineering and executive level.
Commercial awareness: the ability to spot opportunities to reduce cost, simplify delivery, and open new market segments through better solution design.
Project management experience and the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
Satellite communication (SATCOM) systems knowledge and experience is a plus.
Experience with cloud-hosted networking and security (e.g. Azure- or AWS-hosted NGFW) is a plus.


What We'll Offer


Competitive Salary
Performance related bonus
Competitive Health Benefits including optical and dental plan
Pension Scheme
30 days Paid Time Off
Paid Public Holidays
Share Options
Monthly phone allowance

Quvia will never ask job applicants or new hires to send money or deposit checks for the company. In case of doubt, please contact us directly at hr-recruitment@quvia.ai

The Mission:

Real estate is one of the largest, slowest-to-change markets on earth — trillions of dollars in transactions still run on fragmented data, manual workflows, and software that automates paperwork instead of doing the work. We believe that era is over. At Soar, we are building an agentic-first platform: products where AI agents don’t just assist people, they do the work — sourcing, analyzing, negotiating, coordinating, and closing — with humans setting direction and judgment. Most companies are bolting a chatbot onto legacy software. We are doing the opposite: designing the product around autonomous and semi-autonomous agents as the primary way work gets done, with interfaces, data, and trust models built to match. As CPO, you will own this thesis end to end.

What “agentic-first” means here:


Most companies are bolting a chatbot onto legacy software. We are doing the opposite: designing the product around autonomous and semi-autonomous agents as the primary way.
work gets done, with interfaces, data, and trust models built to match. As CPO, you will own this thesis end to end.
Agents as the core unit of the product, rather than features that wrap a model around old workflows.
Outcomes over interfaces — the product should accomplish outcomes, not just surface information.
Trust, transparency, and human-in-the-loop by design — designing for the moments
where the agent acts on the user’s behalf, and where the human stays in control.
Data and feedback as a moat — a learning loop where every transaction makes the next one smarter.

Set the vision. Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for an agentic-first real estate platform — and the conviction behind it.
Build 0 to 1, then 1 to n. Take products from blank page to launch to scale. Define the first wedge, ship fast, learn faster, and expand.

Push the technology. Work hands-on with frontier models, agent frameworks, and emerging tooling. Run experiments others consider too early or too risky.
Take real risks. Make bold, calculated bets with incomplete information — and own the outcomes, good or bad.
Be a force across the company. Partner with engineering, design, GTM, and leadership to align the company behind a coherent product strategy.
Stay obsessed with users. Talk to agents, brokers, buyers, sellers, and investors
constantly. Translate the messy reality of real estate into products people love.


Who you are:


A proven builder. You have built and shipped products that real people used, ideally including 0-to-1 work where you defined the problem, not just the solution.
Creative and unconventional. You think from first principles, question defaults, and are energized by problems with no established playbook.

payloads from external systems.

knowledge.

About Telnyx

Telnyx is an industry leader that's not just imagining the future of global connectivity—we're building it. From architecting and amplifying the reach of a private, global, multi-cloud IP network, to bringing hyperlocal edge technology right to your fingertips through intuitive APIs, we're shaping a new era of seamless interconnection between people, devices, and applications.

We're driven by a desire to transform and modernize what's antiquated, automate the manual, and solve real-world problems through innovative connectivity solutions. As a testament to our success, we're proud to stand as a financially stable and profitable company. Our robust profitability allows us not only to invest in pioneering technologies but also to foster an environment of continuous learning and growth for our team.

Our collective vision is a world where borderless connectivity fuels limitless innovation. By joining us, you can be part of laying the foundations for this interconnected future. We're currently seeking passionate individuals who are excited about the opportunity to contribute to an industry-shaping company while growing their own skills and careers.

The Role

We're building a local Enterprise Sales Pod in Dubai — one AE and one Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), working together to build a Telnyx enterprise business in your market. Enterprise AE — owns the named-account list, builds executive relationships, gets in the room, owns commercial qualification and close, expands the account.

Forward Deployed Engineer — owns technical discovery, designs the architecture, builds the POC when gated, gets the first workload live, removes blockers and finds the next workload.

We sell the workload, not the SKU. Customers buy a production outcome — an AI contact center, a SOC/NOC agent, global communications, connected mobility, or enterprise inference — that runs on Telnyx primitives (voice, messaging, numbers, wireless, Voice AI, inference, agents, connectivity). You lead with the outcome conversation, not a product menu.

Embed with enterprise customers to understand their communications workflows, AI use cases, and integration challenges firsthand

Adapt models to customer domains: prompt and RAG pipelines and evaluation harnesses for Arabic and English language use cases and UAE/GCC-specific regulatory environments (UAE PDPL, Dubai data sovereignty, cloud localization requirements)

Practical understanding of what breaks in front of a model in production: provider rate limits and quotas, timeout and retry behavior, streaming, token accounting and cost attribution, and the failure modes that only show up under concurrency
Comfortable deploying containerized services on Kubernetes, with secrets management, config, and upgrades as part of the deployment story

High-concurrency experience — Kafka, message queues, or event streams at real scale. When throughput spikes you know what breaks — consumer lag, backpressure, hot partitions, rebalance stalls — and what absorbs it: partitioning, consumer groups, parallelism up to your partition count

We build industrial intelligence software for heavy-asset sectors. As a KONGSBERG company backed by over 200 years of heritage, Falkor helps the energy, chemicals, utilities and other industrial sectors operate with absolute clarity, confidence, and control.

Our AI-enabled platform connects people, systems, and workflows—expanding human capability by turning complex data into real-time, actionable decisions. We help leading organizations improve safety, efficiency and performance while redefining how heavy assets are designed and operated.

The role

We are looking for a Senior Fullstack Software Engineer to help design, build, and continuously improve Falkor Horizon and the platform capabilities it depends on. In this role, you will contribute across frontend and backend, take ownership of features from idea to production, and help the team deliver reliable, intuitive, and scalable solutions. We are looking for a flexible, hands-on engineer who can get up to speed quickly and contribute where the team needs it most.

What You’ll Do


Build and improve end-to-end product features across frontend and backend.
Develop intuitive web experiences and scalable backend services, APIs, integrations, and data flows.
Own features through design, implementation, testing, release, and observability.

Strong experience with TypeScript/JavaScript, Node.js, and a modern frontend framework, preferably Angular.

Experience with microservices, event-driven architecture, Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure or AWS.

You'll be joining a global technology company helping to redefine how complex industries operate.

Work on meaningful challenges with real-world impact
Collaborate with talented colleagues across technology and industry domains

If you're excited about solving complex challenges and making an impact through technology, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today with your resume.

Senior Full Stack Engineer (Node/React) - Remote




Kake is a remote-first company and a people-first global community of senior engineers. Kake engineers are behind some of the world’s most innovative products (Brands you’ve heard!), from Fortune 500 to fast-growing companies. We believe it’s not where your table is, but what you bring to the table that matters. Our community spans 45,000+ engineers across 55+ countries; join a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive (and love eating kake!).




We’re looking for Senior Software Engineers specializing in Node.js/React, skilled in building high-performance, scalable systems that support millions of users, and committed to solid architectural judgment and engineering best practices. It's a great fit for people who enjoy owning problems end-to-end, working across the stack, and collaborating closely with product and design to ship reliable, well-crafted software.




What you’ll build and own

Build and ship production features end-to-end across Node.js backends and React frontends, owning your work from implementation through deployment.
Design, build, and version REST or GraphQL APIs that serve as the contract between frontend and backend systems.
Make architecture decisions around data modelling, service boundaries, and component design, applying event-driven thinking where it fits.
Model and query data across relational and NoSQL stores, choosing the right database and structure for each use case.
Write clean, well-tested code and set up the observability needed to catch and debug issues in live systems.




Core Requirements

5+ years of experience in software engineering, with hands-on work in Node.js and React.
Hands-on experience designing and versioning REST or GraphQL APIs.
Experience with modern git workflows, CI/CD, and cloud infrastructure such as GCP, AWS, or Azure.
Strong system-design instincts: data modelling, component architecture, and event-driven thinking.
Comfortable with relational databases and SQL, plus familiarity with NoSQL such as MongoDB or similar.
Strong problem-solving and debugging skills across distributed systems.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
Ability to work independently in a remote, fast-paced environment.




Nice-to-Have

AI-forward mindset with active use of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) to accelerate delivery, while staying the engineer who judges correctness.
Experience with e-commerce, payments, video platforms, or other correctness-critical domains is a strong plus.
Availability to work aligned with the partner's time zone.




Additional

US Timezone Overlap: 5h–6h daily PST




Why Join Kake?

The icing on the Kake:

💰 Competitive Pay in USD: Work globally, get paid globally.
🌎 Fully Remote: Simply put, we trust you.
💜 Better Me Fund: We invest in your personal growth and passions.
🎂 Compassion is Badass: Join a community that invests in social good.




Ready for your piece of the Kake? Apply now!




Quick note: Due to the high volume of applications, only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About The Job

In this pivotal role, you will leverage your expertise to build robust, scalable, and secure backend solutions that contribute to Tether’s mission of pioneering a decentralized future in digital finance. This is an opportunity to take on formidable challenges and make a significant impact on our cutting-edge, global platform.

TP-Link MEA is looking for a creative, digitally focused Graphic Designer with 2–3 years of hands-on experience to support our marketing activities across multiple markets and business units.




The ideal candidate should go beyond traditional graphic design and have strong exposure to digital content, social media creatives, video editing, motion graphics, 3D visualization and AI-powered creative tools. The candidate should understand current design and content trends and be able to translate marketing briefs into modern, engaging and brand-consistent creative output.




What you will do?

Key Responsibilities:




Create high-quality designs for digital campaigns, social media, paid media, websites, e-commerce and email marketing.
Develop print and offline marketing materials including POSM, retail branding, event branding, brochures, flyers, banners, backdrops, roll-ups and other marketing collateral.
Create engaging social media posts, carousels, stories, GIFs, Reels and short-form videos.
Edit product, event, promotional and social media videos.
Create motion graphics, typography animations, transitions and basic visual effects.
Develop basic to intermediate 3D models, renders and visualizations for exhibition stands, event spaces, retail displays, product showcases, POSM and marketing concepts.
Create 3D product mock-ups and environment visualizations to help stakeholders understand creative concepts before production.
Adapt master creatives into different formats and sizes for Meta, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, websites, e-commerce and other platforms.
Use AI-powered creative tools for image generation, image enhancement, video generation/editing, concept development and creative experimentation.
Convert marketing briefs into creative concepts rather than simply executing artwork.
Work closely with Marketing and Business teams to understand the objective, target audience, key products/models and priority messages before starting the design.
Keep communication clear and designs visually strong by avoiding unnecessary text and maintaining proper visual hierarchy.
Ensure highlighted products, models, specifications and messaging are confirmed before final execution.
Maintain brand consistency across different product categories, countries and marketing channels.
Support event photography/videography and content creation when required.
Manage multiple design requests simultaneously and deliver within agreed timelines.
Stay updated on the latest graphic design, social media, video, 3D visualization, AI and digital content trends and proactively recommend new creative approaches.




What talent do you bring?

Required Skills & Experience




2–3 years of professional graphic design experience, preferably within a marketing team, agency, technology, consumer electronics or similar fast-paced environment.
Strong proficiency in Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator and InDesign.
Good working knowledge of Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects.
Experience creating both static and motion/video content.
Working knowledge of 3D design and rendering tools such as Blender, Cinema 4D, SketchUp, 3ds Max or equivalent software.
Ability to create 3D mock-ups, product visualizations, exhibition/event stand concepts and retail/display renders is a strong advantage.
Strong understanding of social-first design and content formats for Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube and Meta advertising.
Hands-on exposure to modern AI image and video generation/editing tools such as Adobe Firefly, Midjourney, Runway, Kling, Veo, ChatGPT or equivalent emerging tools.
Familiarity with Figma, Canva and CapCut is an advantage.
Good understanding of typography, composition, layout, visual hierarchy, branding and colour principles.
Understanding of print production requirements and preparing artwork for vendors.
Ability to resize and localize campaigns across multiple markets while maintaining brand consistency.
Strong attention to detail, particularly for product names, model numbers, specifications, dimensions and brand guidelines.
Ability to take feedback positively, make revisions quickly and manage multiple deadlines.
Good written and verbal communication skills in English.




What we are looking for?

Creative and trend-aware – understands what looks current rather than relying only on traditional design styles.

Digital-first – comfortable designing for social media, digital advertising and short-form content.

AI-enabled – actively uses new AI creative technologies to improve speed, quality and creative possibilities.

3D-capable – able to visualize products, event spaces, retail displays and creative concepts in 3D.

Multi-skilled – capable of handling static design, video editing, motion graphics and 3D visualization.

Marketing-oriented – understands that design should support a business or campaign objective.

Detail-oriented – checks content, models, specifications and formats before artwork is finalized.

Fast and adaptable – able to work across different brands, products, markets and requirements.




About TP-Link:




TP-Link is a global provider of networking products, offering innovative solutions to connect people, businesses, and communities to the possibilities of the digital world. With a commitment to quality and cutting-edge technology, TP-Link continues to be a leader in the networking industry.




With a proven heritage of stability, performance, and value, TP-Link has curated a portfolio of products that meet the networking needs of all individuals. Now, as the connected lifestyle continues to evolve, TP-Link is expanding today to exceed the demands of tomorrow.




Join us in shaping the future of technology. Your next career move could be at TP-Link!

About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Want to build something people actually use?

We are an established European company with operations across Europe, the Middle East and Australia. Our international business is growing, and so is our ambition for the technology behind it.

We’re looking for a developer who wants to do more than pick up tickets. You’ll work closely with our CTO and a small technology team to improve the applications our teams use every day and build the next generation of our digital platform.

You’ll have real ownership, direct contact with the people using your work and the opportunity to grow as our technology team grows.

International websites, ecommerce and customer portals
Internal applications for sales, operations, inventory and finance
React and Next.js applications
Existing PHP systems and new services
APIs, webhooks and integrations with ERP, CRM, Microsoft and payment systems
AWS infrastructure, deployment and monitoring
Workflow automation and AI features that solve real business problems

Some of our systems are modern. Others need improvement. You’ll help us decide what to keep, what to change and what to build next.


AI is part of the job

We want to use AI to make our software and workflows smarter. That could mean processing documents, helping people find information or building agents that can complete clearly defined tasks.

You should be comfortable working with language model APIs, tool calling and automation platforms. You also know that useful AI needs good data, testing, security, permissions and human approval where it matters.

We encourage the use of tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, n8n and Make. What matters most is what you can build with them.

Node.js, REST APIs and system integrations
MySQL or PostgreSQL and sound database design
Git, AWS, Docker and CI/CD
Authentication, role-based access, application security and testing

Why join us?

You’ll join a multicultural team in Dubai and work on projects used across several countries. Decisions are made quickly, your ideas will be heard and you’ll have the freedom to take ownership of meaningful work.

We support training, courses and professional certifications because we want our developers to keep learning. As the team grows, there is room for you to grow into a technical leadership role.


Show us what you can do

Skip the generic cover letter. Apply through this vacancy and share your GitHub, portfolio, a product you built or an automation you’re proud of.




Build useful software. Explore new technology. Make an impact.

jobs.description:
Own on-site conversion end to end for a $1Billion+ e-commerce brand. Find where the revenue is leaking, and decide what changes.




Up to AED 37,000/month (tax-free) + monthly performance bonus of up to 25% of base




Location: Dubai, UAE (On-site) with relocation assistance and visa support




Growth path from here is Director of Conversion & Experimentation → fluid scope at the intersection of experimentation, merchandising strategy, and site revenue ownership. What takes 4-5 years elsewhere happens in 1-2 here.




We've been AI-first since December 2023: session recordings and heatmap data run through AI summarisation before a hypothesis is written, and test concepts are generated and pressure-tested with AI before they reach Design. You'd be building on a foundation, not evangelising one.




Role Overview

Puffy, a market-leading, nine-figure D2C brand and Top 5 US mattress brand with over $1Billion in sales, is hiring a Senior CRO Manager to own on-site conversion rate optimization with authority over the experimentation roadmap, UX and merchandising direction, purchase-journey design, and the optimization backlog, reporting directly to the VP Digital Experience & Conversion.




This role exists to convert behavioural and quantitative data into revenue the business can bank, building the hypothesis pipeline, testing standards, and prioritisation system that let conversion improve without executive attention on every decision. It is a senior individual-contributor seat with no direct reports, where influence comes from evidence.




The Problems You'll Own:

Primary: Grow conversion on a site that already converts: A three-person analytics team owns the data infrastructure and pipelines, so tracking and reporting are already built — you start with clean data, not six months of tagging. The site receives high traffic supported by $2M+/month in digital advertising, but test duration depends on eligible traffic, conversion rates, and the size of the effect being measured and a tenth of a percent is material revenue — but mattresses are high-consideration, signal per visitor is thin, and a premium brand standard sets the bar every test has to clear. The problem is deciding what to test, in what order, and being right often enough that Revenue Per Visitor moves.
Secondary: Make the commercial levers earn their place: Pricing presentation, comparisons, bundles, upsells, promotional messaging, trust signals, and risk reversal have the most direct line to Revenue Per Visitor, and are most often set by habit, not evidence. Each carries a brand cost if pushed too hard on a premium product. The work is establishing which of them move a high-consideration buyer, and at what intensity.




The Career Accelerator

This is not a role where you run someone else's backlog, wait on a roadmap you didn't write, and report results after the decision was made. The scope is scarce: very few Senior CRO Managers own the experimentation roadmap, UX and merchandising direction, pricing and promotional psychology, and the commercial outcome at once, with a direct line to the VP Digital Experience & Conversion and no layers in between.




Your first 12 months: build the prioritized optimization backlog and the logic that ranks it. Run the experimentation roadmap end to end — hypothesis, experiment design, implementation, QA, launch, analysis, validation. Rebuild the mobile purchase journey around viewport priority, information hierarchy, and progressive disclosure. Restructure pricing, comparisons, bundles, upsells, trust signals, and risk reversal against conversion evidence. Set the testing standards Design and Development work against. Cross-reference paid-media performance against on-site behaviour to find where the next conversion opportunity sits. Shape the future of conversion optimization at Puffy, where on-site performance decides the return on $2M+/month in digital advertising.




What Is In It For You

This isn't just another CRO role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.




Full Ownership of the Conversion Agenda

You set the optimization agenda, build the testing system, and own the commercial outcomes.

You decide what gets tested and in what order, design the experiments, and direct Design and Development on layout, hierarchy, imagery, and interaction. The backlog is yours, and so is the reasoning behind it.
You're accountable for conversion rate and Revenue Per Visitor rather than test volume, and you present the evidence behind every recommendation to senior leadership. Diagnosis comes before prescription.




Join a High-Performance Organization and Partner with the 1%:

🏆 Puffy: Top 5 Mattress Brand in US with Over $1Billion USD in Sales

🌍 Great Place to Work Certified

💡 Work directly with Forbes Council Member CEO. Your vision is the company's vision.

Gain firsthand exposure to strategic decisions and high-velocity execution that drives a global brand




Experience a World-Class Lifestyle

Dubai offers a tax-free salary, world-class infrastructure, year-round sunshine, and a global lifestyle that most professionals only experience later in their careers. Your entire compensation package lands in your account — no deductions, no surprises.




Become the CRO Operator Other DTC Brands Try to Hire

In most companies, conversion specialists inherit a backlog somebody else prioritised and spend three years defending flat results. Here you build it. When the business decides where site revenue comes from next quarter, your evidence is the input to that decision, not a report on it afterwards. You'll leave with an experimentation system you designed end to end, and proof that it moved Revenue Per Visitor on a high-traffic, high-consideration site — the part almost nobody in this function can show. Puffy has been AI-First since December 2023, so you'll build it with an AI-native toolbox behind you rather than a queue of unprioritised test requests in front of you.




What You'll Need

5+ years of hands-on CRO and e-commerce analytics in high-traffic environments, with measurable revenue impact from experimentation.
Advanced GA4 analytics (funnels, custom explorations) plus behavioral tools (Hotjar, FullStory, Clarity), turning user data into hypotheses.
End-to-end A/B and multivariate testing on Optimizely, VWO, or Convert, with statistical rigor: sample sizing, significance, common pitfalls.
Strong visual and UI judgment: spot weaknesses in hierarchy, imagery, layout, and interaction, and give designers clear, actionable direction.
Deep mobile-first CRO: viewport priority, information hierarchy, progressive disclosure, sticky interactions, page density, conversion-path friction.
Premium DTC design and merchandising sense, balancing brand perception, visual quality, consumer clarity, and conversion performance.
Commercial acumen across pricing psychology, comparisons, bundles, upsells, trust signals, risk reversal, and conversion copywriting.
Self-service analysis in BI tools such as Looker or Tableau to investigate performance, analyze segments, and build hypotheses.
Advanced AI use across CRO research, behavioral analysis, hypothesis development, visual concepts, and competitive analysis — embedded in your process, not occasional assistance.
Strong ownership and communication to run concurrent initiatives and present data-backed insights to senior leadership.




Good-to-Have

Experience with high-consideration DTC brands, particularly sleep, wellness, or comfort products.
Experience with Shopify or Shopify Plus.
Working knowledge of SQL for querying and validating behavioral and transactional data.

Experience with advanced segmentation, customer lifetime value analysis, or predictive modeling.
Background in performance marketing or paid media analytics.

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Location: Dubai, UAE

What You Will Do As a Customer Engineer

The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.

Key Responsibilities


Technical Validation: Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.
Customer Adoption & Value Realization: Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices. Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.
Commercial Accountability & Expansion: Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.
Trusted Advisory: Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes.
AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.
Education & Enablement: Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.



Minimum Qualifications


Fluency in English and Arabic (written and spoken).
Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services, Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).

Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.
Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.

You will work closely with cross-functional engineering teams to deliver scalable, secure, and high-performance software solutions that power Symbotic's next-generation automation systems.

What We Do

The Cloud Tool and Application Team is part of the Software Engineering organization, which is responsible for building the software platforms, tools, and services that power Symbotic's industry-leading warehouse automation solutions. Our team develops cloud-native applications, monitoring platforms, digital twin technologies, simulation systems, and operational tools that enable real-time visibility, diagnostics, fleet management, and business-critical engineering workflows across our robotics ecosystem.

Design, develop, and maintain modern fullstack web applications (React, Next.js), backend services (Node.js), APIs, and cloud-based tools for digital twin and simulation systems.

Perform other related duties as reasonably assigned by the direct manager or the Employer.


What You’ll Need


5+ years of professional experience in fullstack software development, with strong experience across both frontend and backend platforms.
Strong experience with JavaScript / TypeScript, Node.js, and modern frontend frameworks such as React.js and Next.js.
Solid experience designing and building scalable backend services, RESTful APIs, real-time services, and cloud-based applications.

Experience with data processing pipelines, event-driven systems, real-time data streams, or high-volume telemetry data.
Familiarity with cloud development and deployment on platforms such as Google Cloud Platform and/or Microsoft Azure.
Experience working with databases and data platforms such as MongoDB, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, or similar systems.
Experience with messaging and streaming systems such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, ZeroMQ, NATS, or similar technologies.

Plus{{:}} Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Windsurf, or similar tools.
Good teamwork, communication, time management, ownership, and problem-solving skills.
Working proficiency in verbal and written English, with the ability to communicate independently in an international environment and clearly present technical concepts, findings, risks, and recommendations to leadership stakeholders.


Our Environment


Up to 10% of travel may be required. Employees must have a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client and other customer locations.
Employees may be required to use a personal credit card for business travel expenses, which are reimbursed based on the program guidelines. Eligible employees may receive a corporate credit card based on role and travel requirements, but a personal credit card may be needed during onboarding until the corporate card is issued.


About Symbotic

Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end-to-end, AI-powered robotic and software platform. Symbotic reinvents the warehouse as a strategic asset for the world’s largest retail, wholesale, and food & beverage companies. Applying next-gen technology, high-density storage and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges, Symbotic enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility, accuracy and efficiency. As the backbone of commerce the Symbotic platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. For more information, visit www.symbotic.com.

jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Location: Dubai, UAE

What You Will Do As a Customer Engineer

The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil, so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.

Key Responsibilities


Technical Validation: Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.
Customer Adoption & Value Realization: Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices. Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.
Commercial Accountability & Expansion: Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.
Trusted Advisory: Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes.
AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.
Education & Enablement: Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.



Minimum Qualifications


Fluency in English and Turkish (written and spoken).
Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services, Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal levelling).
Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.
Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.
Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.
Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.
Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:

Our Operating Principles

Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”

Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus

Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy

Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

First-Principles Thinking

Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

You own hypothesis generation, test design, statistical analysis, and the business recommendation that follows.




You build your own pipelines across Shopify, GA4, Google Ads, and BigQuery. No waiting in a queue for data, no presenting metrics without a point of view. 🌍 Great Place to Work Certified

4. Become the Person Who Knows Why Things Convert

In most companies, analysts report numbers. Here, you're the person who tells the business what to change and why. When a test wins or loses, your analysis is the reason leadership moves. You'll build the instinct to separate signal from noise across segments, devices, and traffic sources, and the communication skills to make non-technical stakeholders act on what you find. Job Description

If you are a Senior Application Developer with deep full-stack expertise in Node.js and React, this role offers the opportunity to take technical ownership of enterprise web applications, designing scalable backend services, architecting Progressive Web App experiences, and raising the engineering bar across the team. You will build Node.js REST API services, deliver mobile-friendly React PWA front-ends, and lead MongoDB-backed data architecture decisions within Emerson's Lifecycle Services IT organization.

If this sounds like a perfect fit for you, apply now and join our team in Mandaluyong City, Philippines!

In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:


Lead the design and delivery of complex full-stack features, owing technical decisions from data model and API contract design through React PWA front-end implementation and production deployment.
Architect and build scalable Node.js backend services and RESTful APIs using Express.js or NestJS, defining patterns for authentication, error handling, versioning, and performance that junior developers follow.
Lead PWA architecture decisions, including service worker strategy, offline-first caching design (Cache API, Workbox), push notification infrastructure, and app installability, while setting the standard for PWA implementation across the team.
Design MongoDB data models and aggregation strategies for complex application requirements, enforce NoSQL data modeling best practices, and guide data architecture decisions across the team.
Deliver mobile-friendly React front-end interfaces, including responsive layouts, touch-optimized interactions, and performance tuning for users across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
Drive code quality across the team, set standards, lead code reviews, identify and resolve technical debt proactively, and ensure consistent engineering practices.
Mentor and support mid-level and junior developers through code reviews, pair programming, and technical guidance.
Conduct root cause analysis on complex production incidents, lead performance profiling and optimization across Node.js, MongoDB, and React/PWA layers.
Contribute to technical roadmap discussions, providing engineering input on feasibility, risk, and build-vs-buy decisions for new platform capabilities.
Participate in Agile ceremonies, contribute to sprint planning, and support delivery of team commitments.


Who You Are:

You analyze multiple and diverse sources of information to define problems accurately before moving to solutions. You make good and timely technical decisions that keep the team moving forward even under ambiguity or incomplete information. You act with a clear sense of ownership and take personal responsibility for decisions, actions, and failures. You effectively communicate in various settings and provide timely, helpful information across the organization. You create teamwork that enables others to achieve shared objectives and act as a natural technical enabler for the people around you.

For This Role, You Will Need:


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
8+ years of full-stack web development experience with demonstrated depth in Node.js backend and React frontend delivery.
Expert-level proficiency in building and operating production Node.js services with Express.js or NestJS, including RESTful API design, middleware architecture, authentication (JWT/OAuth2), performance tuning, and service reliability.
Deep expertise in React development, including component architecture, hooks, state management (Redux or Context API), code splitting, performance optimization, and delivering consistent experiences across device sizes.
Proven experience architecting and shipping Progressive Web Applications (PWA) solutions, including service worker lifecycle management, offline-first caching strategies (Cache API, Workbox), web app manifest, push notifications, and installability.
Proven experience delivering web applications optimized for mobile and tablet, responsive and touch-optimized design, mobile performance profiling, Core Web Vitals, and cross-device testing.
Strong hands-on experience with MongoDB, including document and collection design, aggregation pipelines, indexing strategies, performance optimization, and data model design.
Expertise in designing, documenting, and governing REST APIs, including authentication patterns, versioning, contract design, and integration with third-party enterprise services.
Solid familiarity with Git branching strategies, Azure DevOps or similar CI/CD pipelines, and sprint-based delivery; strong English communication skills.


Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart


Experience with advanced Workbox strategies, such as background sync, periodic background fetch, and complex multi-layer caching architectures.
Familiarity with Web Push API and push notification infrastructure (FCM, VAPID keys).
Experience with GraphQL or WebSocket-based real-time application patterns.
Knowledge of microservices architecture, including service decomposition, inter-service communication, and API gateway patterns.
Experience with automated testing at scale such as Jest, Cypress, Playwright, PWA-specific offline and installability testing.
Familiarity with Docker and containerized deployment pipelines, and Azure DevOps CI/CD experience.
Exposure to cloud platforms preferably Microsoft Azure, for application hosting, monitoring, and deployment

At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing. We prioritize providing competitive benefits plans, a variety of medical insurance plans, Employee Assistance Program, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation, and holiday leave.

WHY EMERSON

Our Commitment to Our People

At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration.

We have built an engaged community of inquisitive, dedicated people who thrive knowing they are welcomed, trusted, celebrated, and empowered to solve the world’s most complex problems — for our customers, our communities, and the planet. You’ll contribute to this vital work while further developing your skills through our award-winning employee development programs. Technical Leadership & Architecture

Experience making high-impact design decisions with clear reasoning around trade-offs — scalability vs. cost, performance vs. maintainability, speed vs. reliability

Experience with monitoring and observability tools (e.g., CloudWatch, Sentry, or similar) — instrumenting services, creating dashboards, configuring alerts, and using distributed tracing to diagnose issues
Experience writing tests across the stack — unit, integration, and E2E (Jest, Jasmine/Karma, Playwright or similar)
General understanding of AWS services beyond messaging — S3, IAM, Lambda, EC2, or similar
A business-minded approach to engineering — comfort connecting technical work to company goals, growth metrics, and customer outcomes
Excellent research and investigation skills — able to navigate unfamiliar codebases and ambiguous technical challenges systematically
Strong problem-resolution mindset — thorough, communicative, and effective under pressure
Ability to plan and own complex features independently from design through to production
Strong communication skills and comfort working in a remote, async-friendly environment


BONUS POINTS


Experience in InsurTech, FinTech, or other regulated industries
Experience supporting growth engineering — experimentation platforms, A/B testing frameworks, funnel analytics, or conversion optimization
Experience with agentic coding and AI-assisted development workflows — using tools like Claude Code to accelerate delivery while maintaining quality

jobs.description:
About Sift

Sift is the data infrastructure platform for hardware engineering teams. We turn high-frequency telemetry into engineering insights for mission-critical machines: rockets, satellites, autonomous vehicles, energy systems, and defense platforms. Founded by former SpaceX engineers, we are building the review and analysis layer for the AI era of physical systems.

About The Role

Hardware programs generate far more telemetry than any team can review by hand. Sift Agents is our answer: AI agents that work alongside hardware engineers, investigating anomalies, reviewing test and flight data, and answering in minutes questions that used to take a day of scripting.

This role comes with real product ownership and autonomy. You will talk directly to customers to understand how they review their machines, decide what to build, and own it from first MVP through every iteration after it ships. The surface area is wide: one day you might be polishing the micro-interactions that make the chat experience feel great, the next you might be building a bespoke caching layer for the chat messages off the main JS thread. We’re heavy users of frontier agentic products ourselves and have strong opinions about what makes them great. Sift Agents is where we put those opinions to work.

This is a product engineering role, not a research role. Most of the work is the hard part of making agents feel dependable in the browser: streaming interactions, long-running tasks, rendering agent output over large real-time datasets, and showing engineers exactly what an agent did and why.

In This Role, You'll


Talk directly to customers and partner with product to turn real review workflows into agent capabilities: generating dashboards, writing analysis scripts, and surfacing insights buried in their telemetry
Build the frontend surfaces where Sift Agents live, and make them feel great
Design the interaction patterns of agentic UX: streaming responses, long-running tasks, interruptions, and showing an agent’s work so engineers can trust it
Render an agent’s findings alongside the telemetry that backs them, and keep it fast even when the data is large
Push the browser to its limits when the data demands it: Web Workers, OPFS-backed caching, and stepping outside React when the framework becomes the bottleneck
Contribute to the component library to keep agentic UI patterns consistent across the product
Collaborate with backend and full stack engineers on the API design that powers agent sessions


The Skillset You'll Bring


8+ years of professional software engineering experience
Get excited about owning a product area: talking to customers, deciding what to build, and shipping it
Have built complex, high-performance web applications with technologies like React, NextJS, TypeScript, or similar
Have an eye for detail: you notice the micro-interactions, latency, drops in FPS, and polish that separate good interfaces from exceptional ones
Are curious about new AI products: you try new agents, models, and features as they ship, and have opinions about what makes them good


If this role excites you, apply even if you don’t check every box.

Bonus Points


Shipped products to users at scale: large data volumes, significant active user counts, or deep technical complexity
Shipped LLM-powered features
Built chat or agentic interfaces: streaming responses, tool-call rendering, long-running tasks
A strong understanding of web performance optimization and browser rendering
Worked with modern CSS (Tailwind) and component libraries (Radix UI) to build design systems
Used technical visualization tools (WebGL, D3.js, Apache ECharts), WebAssembly, and time-series data
Built tools for technical users (dashboards, data-editing environments)
A personal ecosystem of AI dev tooling: custom agents, skills, scripts, or workflows built to ship faster
A background in scientific computing or hardware test and telemetry


Engineering At SIFT

You'll have the opportunity to help evolve and scale our platform because we're still in the early stages of building the product. Relevant technologies include:


Web frontend & backend: React, TypeScript, Redux, Tailwind, WebAssembly, D3.js, WebGL, and Go
Data: Parquet, Flink, Kafka, Redpanda, Beam, DuckDB, Timescale, QuestDB, InfluxDB, and Druid
Infrastructure: GitHub Actions, AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, and Terraform


Location:

Sift’s headquarters is in Marina Del Rey, CA (Next to LAX). We collaborate in person twice a week—on Mondays and Thursdays—and come together for a full week every two months. We are open to relocating candidates to LA or working from our San Francisco office for the right candidate.

Salary range: $180,000 - $230,000 per year. Plus equity and benefits.

Eligibility

U.S. Person Required: Must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident, or protected individual such as an asylee or refugee in compliance with ITAR (International Traffic in Arms Regulations) / EAR (Export Administration Regulations) regulations.
